```ts
import { firstValue } from "@/lib/searchParams";

import { COMMENTS_MAX_LIMIT, COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE } from "./limits";

export const REQUESTS_PATH = "/solicitacoes";

/** `/solicitacoes/{id}`; `?comentarios=N` só quando N pede mais que a primeira página de comentários. */
export function requestHref(
  id: string,
  options: { comments?: number } = {},
): string {
  const base = `${REQUESTS_PATH}/${id}`;
  const comments = options.comments;
  return comments !== undefined && comments > COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE
    ? `${base}?comentarios=${Math.floor(comments)}`
    : base;
}

/** A lista de solicitações; o admin leva o setor escolhido (id ou "todos"). */
export function requestsHref(sector?: string | null): string {
  if (sector === undefined || sector === null || sector === "") {
    return REQUESTS_PATH;
  }
  return `${REQUESTS_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ setor: sector }).toString()}`;
}

/** ?comentarios=: múltiplo de 50 entre 50 e 500 (arredonda para baixo); lixo, zero ou ausente → 50. */
export function parseCommentsLimit(raw: string | string[] | undefined): number {
  const value = firstValue(raw);
  if (value === undefined || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE;
  const rounded =
    Math.floor(Number(value) / COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE) * COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE;
  return Math.min(Math.max(rounded, COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE), COMMENTS_MAX_LIMIT);
}
```

```ts
): string {

export function statusConflictMessage(
  status: RequestStatus,
  byName: string,
  at: Date,
): string {
  return `Esta solicitação mudou para ${REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[status]} por ${byName} em ${whenLabel(at)}. Confira e tente de novo.`;

  preview: string,

): string {

/** Toast de falha: Não foi possível mover “{prévia}”. {mensagem} */
export function moveFailedToastMessage(
  preview: string,
  message: string,
): string {
  return `Não foi possível mover “${preview}”. ${message}`;
}
```

```ts
  const query = href.split("?")[1] ?? "";
  return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(query));
}

describe("defaultRequestFilters", () => {
  it("tudo padrão: visão responsiva, todo o período, limites em 20, página 1", () => {
    expect(DEFAULTS).toEqual({
      view: null,
      destination: null,
      period: "all",
      from: null,
      to: null,
      creatorId: null,
      search: "",

        requested: 20,
        in_transit: 20,
        delivered: 20,
        cancelled: 20,
      },
      page: 1,
    });
  });

  it("cada chamada devolve um objeto novo (nunca compartilha os limites)", () => {
    expect(defaultRequestFilters()).not.toBe(defaultRequestFilters());
    expect(defaultRequestFilters().limits).not.toBe(
      defaultRequestFilters().limits,
    );
  });
});

describe("parseRequestFilters", () => {
  it("sem parâmetros: tudo padrão", () => {
    expect(parseRequestFilters({}, TODAY)).toEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });

  it("lixo em todos os parâmetros nunca lança e cai no padrão", () => {
    const garbage = {
      visao: "<script>",
      destino: "'; drop table request;--",
      periodo: "9999",
      de: "ontem",
      ate: "amanhã",
      criador: "../etc/passwd",
      busca: undefined,
      mais_solicitada: "abc",
      mais_transito: "-5",
      mais_entregue: "1e3",
      mais_cancelada: "",
      pagina: "zero",
    };
    expect(parseRequestFilters(garbage, TODAY)).toEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });

  it("parâmetro repetido vale o primeiro", () => {
    const filters = parseRequestFilters(
      {
        visao: ["lista", "tabela"],
        destino: [DEST, "outro"],
        busca: ["a", "b"],
      },
      TODAY,
    );
    expect(filters.view).toBe("list");
    expect(filters.destination).toBe(DEST);
    expect(filters.search).toBe("a");
    expect(parseRequestFilters({ visao: [] }, TODAY).view).toBeNull();
  });

  describe("visão", () => {
    it.each([
      ["quadro", "board"],
      ["lista", "list"],
      ["tabela", "table"],
    ] as const)("visao=%s → %s", (param, view) => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ visao: param }, TODAY).view).toBe(view);
    });

    it.each([
      "QUADRO",
      "board",
      "",
      "kanban",
    ])("visao=%j → padrão responsivo (null)", (param) => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ visao: param }, TODAY).view).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("destino", () => {
    it("uuid minúsculo e 'outro' valem", () => {
      expect(
        parseRequestFilters({ destino: DEST_LETTERS }, TODAY).destination,
      ).toBe(DEST_LETTERS);
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ destino: DEST }, TODAY).destination).toBe(
        DEST,
      );
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ destino: "outro" }, TODAY).destination).toBe(
        "outro",
      );
    });

    it.each([
      "OUTRO",
      "Outro",
      DEST_LETTERS.toUpperCase(),
      "11111111-1111-4111-8111",
      `${DEST} `,
      "todos",
      "",
    ])("%j → null", (param) => {
      expect(
        parseRequestFilters({ destino: param }, TODAY).destination,
      ).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("período", () => {
    it("7 dias = hoje − 6 até hoje; 30 dias = hoje − 29 até hoje", () => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ periodo: "7" }, TODAY)).toMatchObject({
        period: "7",
        from: "2026-11-17",
        to: TODAY,
      });
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ periodo: "30" }, TODAY)).toMatchObject({
        period: "30",
        from: "2026-10-25",
        to: TODAY,
      });
    });

    it("atravessa a virada do ano", () => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ periodo: "7" }, "2026-01-03")).toMatchObject(
        { from: "2025-12-28", to: "2026-01-03" },
      );
    });

    it("ausente ou desconhecido = todo o período, sem datas", () => {
      for (const periodo of [undefined, "", "all", "90", "<x>"]) {
        expect(parseRequestFilters({ periodo }, TODAY)).toMatchObject({
          period: "all",
          from: null,
          to: null,
        });
      }
    });

    describe("intervalo", () => {
      function range(de: string | undefined, ate: string | undefined) {
        return parseRequestFilters({ periodo: "intervalo", de, ate }, TODAY);
      }

      it("de e ate válidos", () => {
        expect(range("2026-11-01", "2026-11-10")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2026-11-01",
          to: "2026-11-10",
        });
      });

      it("um dia só (de = ate)", () => {
        expect(range("2026-11-10", "2026-11-10")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2026-11-10",
          to: "2026-11-10",
        });
      });

      it("invertido é trocado", () => {
        expect(range("2026-11-10", "2026-11-01")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2026-11-01",
          to: "2026-11-10",
        });
      });

      it("ate no futuro é cortado em hoje", () => {
        expect(range("2026-11-01", "2026-12-31")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2026-11-01",
          to: TODAY,
        });
      });

      it("invertido com um lado no futuro: troca e depois corta", () => {
        expect(range("2026-12-31", "2026-11-01")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2026-11-01",
          to: TODAY,
        });
      });

      it("hoje inclusive vale", () => {
        expect(range(TODAY, TODAY)).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: TODAY,
          to: TODAY,
        });
      });

      it("o intervalo todo no futuro cai em todo o período", () => {
        expect(range("2026-12-01", "2026-12-31")).toMatchObject({
          period: "all",
          from: null,
          to: null,
        });
        expect(range("2026-11-24", "2026-11-24").period).toBe("all");
      });

      it("data inválida, inexistente ou ausente cai em todo o período", () => {
        expect(range("2026-02-30", "2026-11-10").period).toBe("all");
        expect(range("2026-11-01", "lixo").period).toBe("all");
        expect(range(undefined, "2026-11-10").period).toBe("all");
        expect(range("2026-11-01", undefined).period).toBe("all");
        expect(range(undefined, undefined).period).toBe("all");
      });

      it("sem teto de extensão: anos de intervalo passam", () => {
        expect(range("2020-01-01", "2026-11-10")).toMatchObject({
          period: "range",
          from: "2020-01-01",
          to: "2026-11-10",
        });
      });

      it("de e ate sem periodo=intervalo são ignorados", () => {
        expect(
          parseRequestFilters({ de: "2026-11-01", ate: "2026-11-10" }, TODAY)
            .period,
        ).toBe("all");
      });
    });
  });

  describe("quem criou", () => {
    it.each(["abc123", "user_1-X", "a".repeat(64)])("%j vale", (id) => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ criador: id }, TODAY).creatorId).toBe(id);
    });

    it.each([
      "",
      "com espaço",
      "a".repeat(65),
      "a/b",
      "ação",
      " abc",
    ])("%j → null", (id) => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ criador: id }, TODAY).creatorId).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("busca", () => {
    it("normaliza: espaços colapsados, trim", () => {
      expect(
        parseRequestFilters({ busca: "  rede   de\nproteção " }, TODAY).search,
      ).toBe("rede de proteção");
    });

    it("só espaços = sem busca", () => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ busca: "   " }, TODAY).search).toBe("");
    });

    it("81 pontos de código com emoji são cortados em 80", () => {
      const search = parseRequestFilters(
        { busca: "🙂".repeat(SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH + 1) },
        TODAY,
      ).search;
      expect(Array.from(search)).toHaveLength(SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH);
    });
  });

  describe("limites do 'Carregar mais'", () => {
    it.each([
      ["0", 20],
      ["19", 20],
      ["20", 20],
      ["39", 20],
      ["40", 40],
      ["45", 40],
      ["199", 180],
      ["200", 200],
      ["999", 200],
      ["99999999999999999999", 200],
      ["abc", 20],
      ["-20", 20],
      ["20.5", 20],
      ["", 20],
    ])("mais_solicitada=%j → %i", (raw, expected) => {
      expect(
        parseRequestFilters({ mais_solicitada: raw }, TODAY).limits.requested,
      ).toBe(expected);
    });

    it("cada status tem o seu parâmetro", () => {
      const filters = parseRequestFilters(
        {
          mais_solicitada: "40",
          mais_transito: "60",
          mais_entregue: "80",
          mais_cancelada: "100",
        },
        TODAY,
      );
      expect(filters.limits).toEqual({
        requested: 40,
        in_transit: 60,
        delivered: 80,
        cancelled: 100,
      });
    });

    it("os nomes dos parâmetros são os do contrato", () => {
      expect(LIMIT_PARAM).toEqual({
        requested: "mais_solicitada",
        in_transit: "mais_transito",
        delivered: "mais_entregue",
        cancelled: "mais_cancelada",
      });
      expect(VIEW_PARAM).toEqual({
        board: "quadro",
        list: "lista",
        table: "tabela",
      });
    });
  });

  describe("página da Tabela", () => {
    it.each([
      ["3", 3],
      ["1", 1],
      ["0", 1],
      ["-2", 1],
      ["1.5", 1],
      ["x", 1],
      ["10001", 1],
    ])("pagina=%j → %i", (raw, expected) => {
      expect(parseRequestFilters({ pagina: raw }, TODAY).page).toBe(expected);
    });
  });
});

describe("buildRequestsHref", () => {
  it("sem nada fora do padrão, só o caminho", () => {

        to: TODAY,

  it("busca com acento, espaço e & sai codificada e volta igual", () => {

  it("setor vazio não entra", () => {

  it("limite 20 e página 1 nunca entram", () => {
    expect(
      buildRequestsHref({ ...DEFAULTS, limits: DEFAULTS.limits, page: 1 }),
    ).toBe("/solicitacoes");
  });
});

describe("ida e volta: parse(build(parse(x))) = parse(x)", () => {
  const CASES: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>[] = [
    {},
    { visao: "lista" },
    { visao: "quadro", destino: "outro", periodo: "30", busca: "rede" },
    { periodo: "7", criador: "ana", pagina: "3" },
    { periodo: "intervalo", de: "2026-11-10", ate: "2026-11-01" },
    { periodo: "intervalo", de: "2026-12-01", ate: "2026-12-05" },
    { mais_solicitada: "60", mais_cancelada: "200", visao: "lista" },
    { busca: "  Separação   Rápida ", destino: DEST },
    { visao: "x", destino: "y", periodo: "z", pagina: "-1" },
  ];

  it.each(CASES)("%j", (raw) => {
    const parsed = parseRequestFilters(raw, TODAY);
    const href = buildRequestsHref(parsed);
    expect(parseRequestFilters(paramsOf(href), TODAY)).toEqual(parsed);
    // e o href gerado a partir do que voltou é o mesmo (estável)
    expect(buildRequestsHref(parseRequestFilters(paramsOf(href), TODAY))).toBe(
      href,
    );
  });

  it("o padrão não deixa nenhum parâmetro", () => {
    expect(
      buildRequestsHref(
        parseRequestFilters({ visao: "x", pagina: "1" }, TODAY),
      ),
    ).toBe("/solicitacoes");
  });
});
```

```ts
    const next = applyMove(groups, { id: moving.id, to: "cancelled", at: AT });
    expect(next.requested.rows).toEqual([]);
    expect(next.requested.total).toBe(0);
    expect(Object.keys(next)).toEqual(["requested", "in_transit", "delivered"]);
  });

  it("na Lista (4 grupos) Cancelada recebe o cartão no topo", () => {
    const moving = requestListItem();
    const old = requestListItem({ status: "cancelled" });
    const groups = toGroupView(requestGroups([moving, old]));
    const next = applyMove(groups, { id: moving.id, to: "cancelled", at: AT });
    expect(ids(next.cancelled.rows)).toEqual([moving.id, old.id]);
    expect(next.cancelled.total).toBe(2);
  });

  it("a contagem da origem nunca fica negativa", () => {
    const moving = requestListItem();
    // total do servidor desatualizado (0) com uma linha na tela.
    const groups = boardOf([moving], { requested: 0 });
    const next = applyMove(groups, { id: moving.id, to: "in_transit", at: AT });
    expect(next.requested.total).toBe(0);
  });

  it("não muta a entrada (grupos, linhas e cartão)", () => {
    const moving = requestListItem();
    const groups = boardOf([moving, requestListItem({ status: "delivered" })]);
    const before = structuredClone(groups);
    const next = applyMove(groups, { id: moving.id, to: "delivered", at: AT });
    expect(groups).toEqual(before);
    expect(next).not.toBe(groups);
    expect(next.requested).not.toBe(groups.requested);
    expect(groups.requested.rows[0]?.pending).toBe(false);
  });

  it("dois movimentos seguidos: o segundo parte do resultado do primeiro", () => {
    const moving = requestListItem();
    const groups = boardOf([moving]);
    const first = applyMove(groups, {
      id: moving.id,
      to: "in_transit",
      at: AT,
    });
    const second = applyMove(first, { id: moving.id, to: "delivered", at: AT });
    expect(second.in_transit.total).toBe(0);
    expect(ids(second.delivered.rows)).toEqual([moving.id]);
    expect(second.delivered.total).toBe(1);
  });

  it("a soma dos totais se mantém (o cartão só muda de lugar)", () => {
    const rows = [
      requestListItem(),
      requestListItem(),
      requestListItem({ status: "in_transit" }),
    ];
    const groups = boardOf(rows);
    const sum = (view: typeof groups) =>
      view.requested.total + view.in_transit.total + view.delivered.total;
    const next = applyMove(groups, {
      id: rows[0]?.id ?? "",
      to: "delivered",
      at: AT,
    });
    expect(sum(next)).toBe(sum(groups));
  });
});
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import { BOARD_PAGE_SIZE } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { REQUEST_STATUS_ORDER } from "@/features/requests/status";
import type {
  RequestGroup,
  RequestGroups,
  RequestListItem,
  RequestStatus,
} from "@/features/requests/types";

// Construtores dos testes de componente e do reducer do Quadro. Datas fixas
// (2026-11-20T12:00:00Z): o teste que depende do tempo passa as suas.
const DEFAULT_AT = new Date("2026-11-20T12:00:00Z");

/** Uma linha do Quadro/Lista/Tabela com id único, Solicitada, contadores zerados. */
export function requestListItem(
  overrides: Partial<RequestListItem> = {},
): RequestListItem {
  return {
    id: randomUUID(),
    sectorId: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1",
    sectorName: "Setor Teste",
    description: "Solicitação de teste",
    destinationName: "Doca 3",
    destinationIsOther: false,
    status: "requested",
    createdByName: "Ana Teste",
    createdAt: DEFAULT_AT,
    statusChangedAt: DEFAULT_AT,
    daysInStatus: 0,
    stale: false,
    itemCount: 0,
    commentCount: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/**
 * Agrupa as linhas pelo status (os 4 grupos, na ordem da Lista). `total` =
 * quantas linhas o status tem, ou o que o teste informar (total maior que as
 * linhas = "Carregar mais" pendente); `limit` = BOARD_PAGE_SIZE.
 */
export function requestGroups(
  rows: readonly RequestListItem[],
  totals: Partial<Record<RequestStatus, number>> = {},
): RequestGroups {
  const group = (status: RequestStatus): RequestGroup => {
    const own = rows.filter((row) => row.status === status);
    return {
      status,
      total: totals[status] ?? own.length,
      limit: BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
      rows: own,
    };
  };
  const [requested, in_transit, delivered, cancelled] =
    REQUEST_STATUS_ORDER.map(group);
  if (!requested || !in_transit || !delivered || !cancelled) {
    throw new Error("requestGroups: faltou um grupo");
  }
  return { requested, in_transit, delivered, cancelled };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 29: Create `src/features/requests/requestFilters.ts`**

```ts
import { parsePage } from "@/features/admin/pagination";
import { addDays, isIsoDate } from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";
import { firstValue } from "@/lib/searchParams";

import { BOARD_MAX_LIMIT, BOARD_PAGE_SIZE, DESTINATION_OTHER } from "./limits";
import { normalizeSearch } from "./search";
import { REQUEST_STATUS_ORDER, STATUS_PARAM } from "./status";
import type { RequestStatus } from "./types";
import { REQUESTS_PATH } from "./urls";

// Filtros da tela de solicitações, todos na URL. O parse nunca lança e só
// devolve valores que o formulário sabe mostrar.
export type RequestView = "board" | "list" | "table";
export const VIEW_PARAM: Readonly<Record<RequestView, string>> = {
  board: "quadro",
  list: "lista",
  table: "tabela",
};

export type RequestPeriod = "all" | "7" | "30" | "range";

export type RequestFilters = {
  view: RequestView | null; // null = padrão responsivo (Lista abaixo de md, Quadro em md+)
  destination: string | null; // uuid | DESTINATION_OTHER | null (todos)
  period: RequestPeriod;
  from: string | null; // "YYYY-MM-DD" em "7"/"30"/"range"; null em "all"
  to: string | null;
  creatorId: string | null; // user.id
  search: string; // normalizeSearch; "" = sem busca
  limits: Record<RequestStatus, number>; // múltiplo de BOARD_PAGE_SIZE entre 20 e 200
  page: number; // Tabela
};

type Params = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;
type Extras = { sector?: string };

// Minúsculo de propósito: um uuid em maiúsculas não é um valor que o seletor gera.
const UUID =
  /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;
const USER_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/;

export const LIMIT_PARAM: Readonly<Record<RequestStatus, string>> = {
  requested: `mais_${STATUS_PARAM.requested}`,
  in_transit: `mais_${STATUS_PARAM.in_transit}`,
  delivered: `mais_${STATUS_PARAM.delivered}`,
  cancelled: `mais_${STATUS_PARAM.cancelled}`,
};

function defaultLimits(): Record<RequestStatus, number> {
  return {
    requested: BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
    in_transit: BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
    delivered: BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
    cancelled: BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
  };
}

export function defaultRequestFilters(): RequestFilters {
  return {
    view: null,
    destination: null,
    period: "all",
    from: null,
    to: null,
    creatorId: null,
    search: "",
    limits: defaultLimits(),
    page: 1,
  };
}

function viewFromParam(param: string | undefined): RequestView | null {
  for (const view of ["board", "list", "table"] as const) {
    if (VIEW_PARAM[view] === param) return view;
  }
  return null;
}

// "0", "45", "999" e lixo viram um múltiplo do passo entre 20 e 200.
function limitFromParam(raw: string | string[] | undefined): number {
  const value = firstValue(raw);
  if (value === undefined || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) return BOARD_PAGE_SIZE;
  const rounded = Math.floor(Number(value) / BOARD_PAGE_SIZE) * BOARD_PAGE_SIZE;
  return Math.min(Math.max(rounded, BOARD_PAGE_SIZE), BOARD_MAX_LIMIT);
}

type Range = { period: RequestPeriod; from: string | null; to: string | null };
const ALL_PERIOD: Range = { period: "all", from: null, to: null };

// Intervalo: invertido é trocado, `ate` futuro é cortado em hoje; tudo no
// futuro ou data inválida cai em "Todo o período". Sem teto de extensão.
function rangeFrom(
  de: string | undefined,
  ate: string | undefined,
  today: string,
): Range {
  if (de === undefined || ate === undefined) return ALL_PERIOD;
  if (!isIsoDate(de) || !isIsoDate(ate)) return ALL_PERIOD;
  const [first, last] = de <= ate ? [de, ate] : [ate, de];
  const to = last > today ? today : last;
  if (first > to) return ALL_PERIOD;
  return { period: "range", from: first, to };
}

function periodFrom(params: Params, today: string): Range {
  switch (firstValue(params.periodo)) {
    case "7":
      return { period: "7", from: addDays(today, -6), to: today };
    case "30":
      return { period: "30", from: addDays(today, -29), to: today };
    case "intervalo":
      return rangeFrom(firstValue(params.de), firstValue(params.ate), today);
    default:
      return ALL_PERIOD;
  }
}

function destinationFrom(param: string | undefined): string | null {
  if (param === DESTINATION_OTHER) return DESTINATION_OTHER;
  return param !== undefined && UUID.test(param) ? param : null;
}

export function parseRequestFilters(
  params: Params,
  today: string,
): RequestFilters {
  const creator = firstValue(params.criador);
  return {
    view: viewFromParam(firstValue(params.visao)),
    destination: destinationFrom(firstValue(params.destino)),
    ...periodFrom(params, today),
    creatorId: creator !== undefined && USER_ID.test(creator) ? creator : null,
    search: normalizeSearch(firstValue(params.busca) ?? ""),
    limits: {
      requested: limitFromParam(params[LIMIT_PARAM.requested]),
      in_transit: limitFromParam(params[LIMIT_PARAM.in_transit]),
      delivered: limitFromParam(params[LIMIT_PARAM.delivered]),
      cancelled: limitFromParam(params[LIMIT_PARAM.cancelled]),
    },
    page: parsePage(params.pagina),
  };
}

/** A URL dos filtros, sem nenhum parâmetro que seja o padrão. */
export function buildRequestsHref(
  filters: RequestFilters,
  extras: Extras = {},
): string {
  const search = new URLSearchParams();
  if (filters.view !== null) search.set("visao", VIEW_PARAM[filters.view]);
  if (filters.destination !== null) search.set("destino", filters.destination);
  if (filters.period === "7" || filters.period === "30") {
    search.set("periodo", filters.period);
  }
  if (filters.period === "range" && filters.from && filters.to) {
    search.set("periodo", "intervalo");
    search.set("de", filters.from);
    search.set("ate", filters.to);
  }
  if (filters.creatorId !== null) search.set("criador", filters.creatorId);
  if (filters.search !== "") search.set("busca", filters.search);
  if (extras.sector) search.set("setor", extras.sector);
  for (const status of REQUEST_STATUS_ORDER) {
    if (filters.limits[status] > BOARD_PAGE_SIZE) {
      search.set(LIMIT_PARAM[status], String(filters.limits[status]));
    }
  }
  if (filters.page > 1) search.set("pagina", String(filters.page));
  const query = search.toString();
  return query === "" ? REQUESTS_PATH : `${REQUESTS_PATH}?${query}`;
}

/** Aplicar filtros volta ao começo: limites em 20 e página 1. */
export function resetPaging(filters: RequestFilters): RequestFilters {
  return { ...filters, limits: defaultLimits(), page: 1 };
}

/** Algum filtro além da visão (decide entre "vazio novo" e "vazio filtrado"). */
export function filtersActive(filters: RequestFilters): boolean {
  return (
    filters.destination !== null ||
    filters.period !== "all" ||
    filters.creatorId !== null ||
    filters.search !== ""
  );
}

/** "Limpar filtros" mantém a visão e o setor. */
export function clearFiltersHref(
  view: RequestView | null,
  extras: Extras = {},
): string {
  return buildRequestsHref({ ...defaultRequestFilters(), view }, extras);
}

/** "Carregar mais" de uma coluna/grupo: mais 20, até 200, mantendo o resto. */
export function moreHref(
  filters: RequestFilters,
  status: RequestStatus,
  extras: Extras = {},
): string {
  const next = Math.min(
    filters.limits[status] + BOARD_PAGE_SIZE,
    BOARD_MAX_LIMIT,
  );
  return buildRequestsHref(
    { ...filters, limits: { ...filters.limits, [status]: next }, page: 1 },
    extras,
  );
}

/** Os três links do seletor de visão: mantêm os filtros e zeram a paginação. */
export function viewHrefs(
  filters: RequestFilters,
  extras: Extras = {},
): Record<RequestView, string> {
  const base = resetPaging(filters);
  return {
    board: buildRequestsHref({ ...base, view: "board" }, extras),
    list: buildRequestsHref({ ...base, view: "list" }, extras),
    table: buildRequestsHref({ ...base, view: "table" }, extras),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { isOpenStatus } from "./status";
import type {
  RequestCardView,
  RequestGroup,
  RequestGroupView,
  RequestStatus,
} from "./types";

// Movimento otimista do Quadro e da Lista: o reducer de useOptimistic. Puro:
// nunca muta a entrada e só usa o instante de `intent.at`.
export type MoveIntent = { id: string; to: RequestStatus; at: Date };

function isKey<K extends string>(
  record: Readonly<Record<K, unknown>>,
  key: string,
): key is K {
  return key in record;
}

function keysOf<K extends string>(record: Readonly<Record<K, unknown>>): K[] {
  return Object.keys(record).filter((key): key is K => isKey(record, key));
}

function isComplete<K extends string, V>(
  partial: Partial<Record<K, V>>,
  keys: readonly K[],
): partial is Record<K, V> {
  return keys.every((key) => key in partial);
}

// Mesmas chaves, valores trocados (sem `as`: a conferência é um type guard).
function mapGroups<K extends RequestStatus, V, W>(
  record: Readonly<Record<K, V>>,
  change: (value: V, key: K) => W,
): Record<K, W> {
  const keys = keysOf(record);
  const result: Partial<Record<K, W>> = {};
  for (const key of keys) result[key] = change(record[key], key);
  if (!isComplete(result, keys)) {
    throw new Error("mapGroups: grupo perdido");
  }
  return result;
}

/** Os grupos do servidor como a tela os mostra: nenhum cartão em voo. */
export function toGroupView<K extends RequestStatus>(
  groups: Readonly<Record<K, RequestGroup>>,
): Record<K, RequestGroupView> {
  return mapGroups(groups, (group) => ({
    ...group,
    rows: group.rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, pending: false })),
  }));
}

/**
 * Move o cartão de grupo: sai da origem (total − 1, nunca < 0) e entra no
 * destino (total + 1) com `pending`. Entregue e Cancelada entram no topo (a
 * mais recente primeiro); uma coluna aberta só ganha o cartão no fim se
 * mostrava tudo (sem "Carregar mais" pendente). Não achou o cartão ou ele já
 * está em `to` → devolve o MESMO objeto. Destino ausente (Cancelada no
 * Quadro) → só sai da origem.
 */
export function applyMove<K extends RequestStatus>(
  groups: Readonly<Record<K, RequestGroupView>>,
  intent: MoveIntent,
): Record<K, RequestGroupView> {
  const keys = keysOf(groups);
  const origin = keys.find((key) =>
    groups[key].rows.some((row) => row.id === intent.id),
  );
  if (origin === undefined) return groups;
  const card = groups[origin].rows.find((row) => row.id === intent.id);
  if (card === undefined || card.status === intent.to) return groups;

  const moved: RequestCardView = {
    ...card,
    status: intent.to,
    statusChangedAt: intent.at,
    daysInStatus: 0,
    stale: false,
    pending: true,
  };

  return mapGroups(groups, (group, key) => {
    if (key === origin) {
      return {
        ...group,
        total: Math.max(0, group.total - 1),
        rows: group.rows.filter((row) => row.id !== intent.id),
      };
    }
    if (key === intent.to) {
      const complete = group.rows.length >= group.total;
      const rows = isOpenStatus(intent.to)
        ? complete
          ? [...group.rows, moved]
          : group.rows
        : [moved, ...group.rows];
      return { ...group, total: group.total + 1, rows };
    }
    return group;
  });
}
```

```ts
function uuid(n: number): string {
  return `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

const SECTOR = uuid(1);
const OTHER_SECTOR = uuid(2);
const DESTINATION = uuid(3);

  items: [],

// O texto padrão do Zod é inglês e nunca pode chegar à tela.
const ZOD_DEFAULT = /Invalid|Too (big|small)|expected|received|Required/i;

function issuesOf(schema: ZodType, input: unknown) {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(input);
  if (parsed.success) return [];
  return parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => ({
    path: issue.path.join("."),
    message: issue.message,
  }));
}

function errorsOf(schema: ZodType, input: unknown): FieldErrors {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(input);
  return parsed.success ? {} : firstFieldErrors(parsed.error);
}

// A primeira mensagem do runner: issue com path vazio vira a genérica.
function firstMessage(schema: ZodType, input: unknown): string | null {
  const issue = issuesOf(schema, input)[0];
  if (!issue) return null;
  return issue.path === "" ? INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE : issue.message;
}

function expectNoZodDefault(schema: ZodType, input: unknown) {
  const issues = issuesOf(schema, input);
  expect(issues.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  for (const issue of issues) expect(issue.message).not.toMatch(ZOD_DEFAULT);
}
```

```ts
import type { RequestDestinationInput, RequestItemInput } from "./types";

// Todo campo e todo z.object têm mensagem em pt-BR própria: o runner devolve a
// mensagem de qualquer issue com path não vazio, e o texto padrão do Zod
// ("Invalid input: expected string…") nunca pode chegar à tela. Os limites
// contam pontos de código (um emoji conta 1).
const textSchema = z.string({ error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE });

export const requestStatusSchema = z.enum(REQUEST_STATUSES, {
  error: INVALID_STATUS_MESSAGE,
});

export const requestItemInputSchema = z.object(
  {
    itemId: idSchema,
    quantity: z
      .number({ error: ITEM_QUANTITY_MESSAGE })
      .int({ error: ITEM_QUANTITY_MESSAGE })
      .min(1, { error: ITEM_QUANTITY_MESSAGE })
      .max(MAX_QUANTITY, { error: ITEM_QUANTITY_MESSAGE }),
  },
  { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
);

export type CreateRequestInput = {
  sectorId: string;
  destination: RequestDestinationInput;
  description: string;
  items: RequestItemInput[];
  originRef: HandoverRef | null;
};

// Todas as validações de texto ficam no superRefine, sobre o texto cru: o
// formulário recebe os erros de todos os campos de uma vez (um campo com
// transform própria esconderia os outros até ser corrigido).
export const createRequestSchema = z
  .object(
    {
      sectorId: idSchema,
      destinationId: idSchema.nullable(), // null = "Outro"
      destinationOther: textSchema, // só vale com destinationId null
      description: textSchema,
      items: z
        .array(requestItemInputSchema, { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE })
        .max(REQUEST_ITEMS_MAX, { error: TOO_MANY_ITEMS_MESSAGE }),
      originRef: z
        .object(handoverRefSchema.shape, { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE })
        .nullable(),
    },
    { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
  )
  .superRefine((value, ctx) => {
    if (
      value.originRef !== null &&
      value.originRef.sectorId !== value.sectorId
    ) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: ORIGIN_SECTOR_MISMATCH_MESSAGE,
        path: ["sectorId"],
      });
    }
    if (value.destinationId === null) {
      const other = normalizeDestinationOther(value.destinationOther);
      if (other === "") {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: DESTINATION_OTHER_REQUIRED_MESSAGE,
          path: ["destinationOther"],
        });
      } else if (codePointLength(other) > DESTINATION_OTHER_MAX_LENGTH) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: DESTINATION_OTHER_TOO_LONG_MESSAGE,
          path: ["destinationOther"],
        });
      }
    }
    const description = normalizeRequestText(value.description);
    if (description === "") {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED_MESSAGE,
        path: ["description"],
      });
    } else if (codePointLength(description) > DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG_MESSAGE,
        path: ["description"],
      });
    }
    const itemIds = value.items.map((line) => line.itemId);
    if (new Set(itemIds).size !== itemIds.length) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: DUPLICATE_ITEM_MESSAGE,
        path: ["items"],
      });
    }
  })
  .transform(
    (value): CreateRequestInput => ({
      sectorId: value.sectorId,
      destination:
        value.destinationId === null
          ? {
              kind: "other",
              text: normalizeDestinationOther(value.destinationOther),
            }
          : { kind: "list", destinationId: value.destinationId },
      description: normalizeRequestText(value.description),
      items: value.items,
      originRef: value.originRef,
    }),
  );

/** O que o RequestForm envia (antes da normalização). */
export type CreateRequestFormInput = z.input<typeof createRequestSchema>;

// Mover para Cancelada não passa por aqui: cancelar tem motivo obrigatório.
export const moveRequestSchema = z
  .object(
    { id: idSchema, from: requestStatusSchema, to: requestStatusSchema },
    { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
  )
  .transform((value, ctx) => {
    if (!isBoardStatus(value.to)) {
      ctx.addIssue({
        code: "custom",
        message: CANCEL_NEEDS_REASON_MESSAGE,
        path: ["to"],
      });
      return z.NEVER;
    }
    return { id: value.id, from: value.from, to: value.to };
  });
export type MoveRequestInput = z.output<typeof moveRequestSchema>;

export const cancelRequestSchema = z.object(
  {
    id: idSchema,
    from: requestStatusSchema,
    reason: textSchema.transform((raw, ctx) => {
      const reason = normalizeRequestText(raw);
      if (reason === "") {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: CANCEL_REASON_REQUIRED_MESSAGE,
        });
        return z.NEVER;
      }
      if (codePointLength(reason) > CANCEL_REASON_MAX_LENGTH) {
        ctx.addIssue({
          code: "custom",
          message: CANCEL_REASON_TOO_LONG_MESSAGE,
        });
        return z.NEVER;
      }
      return reason;
    }),
  },
  { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
);
export type CancelRequestInput = z.output<typeof cancelRequestSchema>;

export const addCommentSchema = z.object(
  {
    requestId: idSchema,
    body: textSchema.transform((raw, ctx) => {
      const body = normalizeRequestText(raw);
      if (body === "") {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: COMMENT_REQUIRED_MESSAGE });
        return z.NEVER;
      }
      if (codePointLength(body) > COMMENT_MAX_LENGTH) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: COMMENT_TOO_LONG_MESSAGE });
        return z.NEVER;
      }
      return body;
    }),
  },
  { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
);
export type AddCommentInput = z.output<typeof addCommentSchema>;

export const deleteCommentSchema = z.object(
  { id: idSchema },
  { error: INVALID_INPUT_MESSAGE },
);
export type DeleteCommentInput = z.output<typeof deleteCommentSchema>;
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Add `NULL_SLOT_PAGES`, `rendersNothing` and the new rules to `src/app/appPagesAuth.test.ts`**

Leia o arquivo. Troque o trecho que vai de `function findPages` até o fim do primeiro `it` do `describe` principal. Antes (como a Tarefa 2 o deixou):

```ts
function findPages(dir: string): string[] {
  return listSourceFiles(dir, (name) => name === "page.tsx");
}

function isAdminPage(file: string): boolean {

}

describe("toda página do grupo (app) chama requireUser ou requireAdmin", () => {

  });
```

Depois:

```ts
// Páginas de slot (rota paralela) que só devolvem null: não leem nada, então não
// há o que proteger. A lista é fechada de propósito: uma página nula que não
// esteja aqui continua precisando do portão, e o guarda reprova. Caminhos
// relativos a src/app/(app), com "/". Entra o slot @detalhe na Tarefa 12.
export const NULL_SLOT_PAGES: readonly string[] = [];

// Verdadeiro só para `export default function Nome() { return null; }`, sem
// nenhum import (comentários não contam).
export function rendersNothing(source: string): boolean {
  return /^export\s+default\s+function\s+[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*\(\s*\)\s*\{\s*return\s+null\s*;?\s*\}\s*;?$/.test(
    stripComments(source).trim(),
  );
}

function findPages(dir: string): string[] {
  return listSourceFiles(dir, (name) => name === "page.tsx");
}

function routeOf(file: string): string {
  return relative(APP_GROUP, file).replaceAll("\\", "/");
}

function isAdminPage(file: string): boolean {
  return routeOf(file).startsWith("admin/");
}

describe("toda página do grupo (app) chama requireUser ou requireAdmin", () => {
  const allPages = findPages(APP_GROUP);
  // As páginas nulas da lista fechada têm a sua própria regra (abaixo).
  const pages = allPages.filter(
    (file) => !NULL_SLOT_PAGES.includes(routeOf(file)),
  );

  it("encontra as páginas guardadas do grupo", () => {
    expect(pages.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12);
  });

  it("a lista fechada de slots nulos: cada entrada é de um slot, existe e só devolve null", () => {
    expect(new Set(NULL_SLOT_PAGES).size).toBe(NULL_SLOT_PAGES.length);
    for (const route of NULL_SLOT_PAGES) {
      expect(route.startsWith("@"), `${route} não é de um slot`).toBe(true);
      const file = allPages.find((candidate) => routeOf(candidate) === route);
      expect(file, `${route} não existe`).toBeDefined();
      if (file === undefined) continue;
      expect(
        rendersNothing(readFileSync(file, "utf8")),
        `${route} faz mais que devolver null: precisa do portão`,
      ).toBe(true);
    }
  });
```

(O resto do arquivo não muda: os `it` seguintes continuam usando `pages`, que agora exclui as páginas da lista fechada, e `isAdminPage`.)

```ts
          toStatus: "requested",
          changedBy: ana.id,
          changedAt: AT,

        await insertRequestEvent(db, {

          fromStatus: "requested",
          toStatus: "in_transit",
          changedBy: bia.id,
          changedAt: AT,

        expect(await lastChange(db, created.id)).toMatchObject({
          status: "in_transit",
          byName: "Bia Teste",
        });
      }
    });
  });

  describe("lockSectorShare", () => {
    it("devolve o setor com o active atual (admin vê o inativo)", async () => {
      const { adminAuthz } = await setup();
      const parado = await insertSector(db, "Setor parado", { active: false });

      const sector = await db.transaction((tx) =>
        lockSectorShare(tx, adminAuthz, parado.id),
      );

      expect(sector).toEqual({
        id: parado.id,
        name: "Setor parado",
        active: false,
      });
    });

    it("operador de outro setor e setor inexistente recebem null", async () => {
      const { uld, biaAuthz, anaAuthz } = await setup();

      const [stranger, missing, own] = await db.transaction(async (tx) => [
        await lockSectorShare(tx, biaAuthz, uld.id),
        await lockSectorShare(tx, anaAuthz, NIL_ID),
        await lockSectorShare(tx, anaAuthz, uld.id),
      ]);

      expect(stranger).toBeNull();
      expect(missing).toBeNull();
      expect(own).toMatchObject({ id: uld.id, active: true });
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { user } from "@/db/schema/auth";
import { request, requestStatusEvent } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import { sector } from "@/db/schema/sectors";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { type Authz, canAccessSector } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import type { SectorRow } from "@/features/handovers/loaders";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

export type RequestRow = typeof request.$inferSelect;

/** null se não existe OU está fora do escopo do operador (a mesma resposta: não revela o que existe). */
export async function findRequestById(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  id: string,
): Promise<RequestRow | null> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(request).where(eq(request.id, id));
  if (!row || !canAccessSector(actor, row.sectorId)) return null;
  return row;
}

/** `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`: use dentro da transação, antes de decidir a mensagem. */
export async function lockRequest(
  tx: Db,
  id: string,
): Promise<RequestRow | null> {
  const [row] = await tx
    .select()
    .from(request)
    .where(eq(request.id, id))
    .for("update");
  return row ?? null;
}

/** O último evento de status (changed_at desc, seq desc) com o nome de quem mudou. */
export async function lastChange(
  db: Db,
  requestId: string,
): Promise<{ status: RequestStatus; byName: string; at: Date } | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      status: requestStatusEvent.toStatus,
      byName: user.name,
      at: requestStatusEvent.changedAt,
    })
    .from(requestStatusEvent)
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, requestStatusEvent.changedBy))
    .where(eq(requestStatusEvent.requestId, requestId))
    .orderBy(desc(requestStatusEvent.changedAt), desc(requestStatusEvent.seq))
    .limit(1);
  return row ?? null;
}

/**
 * `loadSector` com `FOR SHARE` (só dentro de transação): serializa com o
 * `FOR UPDATE` de `setSectorActive`, então um setor desativado no meio não
 * recebe escrita. null se não existe ou está fora do escopo do operador.
 */
export async function lockSectorShare(
  tx: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  sectorId: string,
): Promise<SectorRow | null> {
  const [row] = await tx
    .select({ id: sector.id, name: sector.name, active: sector.active })
    .from(sector)
    .where(eq(sector.id, sectorId))
    .for("share");
  if (!row || !canAccessSector(actor, row.id)) return null;
  return row;
}
```

```ts
import { lockSectorShare } from "./loaders";
import {
  DESTINATION_INACTIVE_MESSAGE,
  ITEM_NOT_ALLOWED_MESSAGE,
  ORIGIN_LOCKED_MESSAGE,
  ORIGIN_SECTOR_MISMATCH_MESSAGE,
} from "./messages";
import type { CreateRequestInput } from "./schemas";

export type CreatedRequest = { id: string };

/**
 * Uma transação: setor (FOR SHARE) → origem (cria o rascunho se preciso) →
 * destino → itens → request + itens + evento NULL → requested. Qualquer falha
 * desfaz tudo, inclusive o rascunho criado por `ensureHandover`.
 */
export async function createRequest(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: CreateRequestInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult<CreatedRequest>> {
  return runInTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const owner = await lockSectorShare(tx, actor, input.sectorId);
    if (!owner) return fail("NOT_FOUND", notFoundMessage("setor"));
    if (!owner.active) {
      return fail("SECTOR_INACTIVE", SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE);
    }

    let originHandoverId: string | null = null;
    if (input.originRef !== null) {
      if (input.originRef.sectorId !== input.sectorId) {
        return fail("INVALID_INPUT", ORIGIN_SECTOR_MISMATCH_MESSAGE, {
          sectorId: ORIGIN_SECTOR_MISMATCH_MESSAGE,
        });
      }
      const ensured = await ensureHandover(tx, actor, input.originRef, now);
      if (!ensured.ok) return ensured;
      // Entregue vale (corrida com o formulário aberto: só liga a solicitação,
      // não escreve em `handover`); confirmada não: o turno já foi recebido.
      if (ensured.row.status === "confirmed") {
        return fail("HANDOVER_LOCKED", ORIGIN_LOCKED_MESSAGE);
      }
      originHandoverId = ensured.row.id;
    }

    let destinationId: string | null = null;
    let destinationOther: string | null = null;
    if (input.destination.kind === "list") {
      const [target] = await tx
        .select({ id: destination.id, active: destination.active })
        .from(destination)
        .where(eq(destination.id, input.destination.destinationId))
        .for("share");
      if (!target) {
        return fail("NOT_FOUND", notFoundMessage("destino"), {
          destinationId: notFoundMessage("destino"),
        });
      }
      if (!target.active) {
        return fail("DESTINATION_INACTIVE", DESTINATION_INACTIVE_MESSAGE, {
          destinationId: DESTINATION_INACTIVE_MESSAGE,
        });
      }
      destinationId = target.id;
    } else {
      destinationOther = input.destination.text;
    }

    const wanted = input.items.map((line) => line.itemId);
    if (new Set(wanted).size !== wanted.length) {
      return fail("INVALID_INPUT", DUPLICATE_ITEM_MESSAGE, {
        items: DUPLICATE_ITEM_MESSAGE,
      });
    }
    const allowed =
      wanted.length === 0
        ? []
        : await tx
            .select({ id: item.id, name: item.name, unit: item.unit })
            .from(item)
            .where(
              and(
                inArray(item.id, wanted),
                eq(item.sectorId, input.sectorId),
                eq(item.kind, "stock"),
                eq(item.active, true),
              ),
            )
            .for("share");
    const byId = new Map(allowed.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
    // Item de outro setor, de controle, inativo ou inexistente: a mesma
    // mensagem, sem revelar o que existe.
    if (wanted.some((id) => !byId.has(id))) {
      return fail("INVALID_INPUT", ITEM_NOT_ALLOWED_MESSAGE, {
        items: ITEM_NOT_ALLOWED_MESSAGE,
      });
    }

    const [created] = await tx
      .insert(request)
      .values({
        sectorId: input.sectorId,
        destinationId,
        destinationOther,
        description: input.description,
        status: "requested",
        createdBy: actor.userId,
        createdAt: now,
        statusChangedAt: now,
        originHandoverId,
      })
      .returning({ id: request.id });
    if (!created) throw new Error("createRequest: solicitação não criada");

    const lines = input.items.flatMap((line) => {
      const source = byId.get(line.itemId);
      return source
        ? [
            {
              requestId: created.id,
              itemId: source.id,
              itemNameSnapshot: source.name,
              itemUnitSnapshot: source.unit,
              quantity: line.quantity,
            },
          ]
        : [];
    });
    if (lines.length > 0) await tx.insert(requestItem).values(lines);

    await tx.insert(requestStatusEvent).values({
      requestId: created.id,
      fromStatus: null,
      toStatus: "requested",
      changedBy: actor.userId,
      changedAt: now,
    });

    return ok({ id: created.id });
  });
}
```

```ts
});
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write minimal implementation de `moveRequest` e `cancelRequest`**

Crie `src/features/requests/move.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import {
  request,
  requestComment,
  requestStatusEvent,
} from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import {
  type AdminFailure,
  type AdminResult,
  fail,
  ok,
} from "@/features/admin/result";
import { runInTransaction } from "@/features/admin/transaction";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE } from "@/features/handovers/messages";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import {
  findRequestById,
  lastChange,
  lockRequest,
  lockSectorShare,
  type RequestRow,
} from "./loaders";
import {
  alreadyCancelledMessage,
  alreadyMovedMessage,
  REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE,
  sameStatusMessage,
  statusConflictMessage,
} from "./messages";
import type { CancelRequestInput, MoveRequestInput } from "./schemas";

export type MovedRequest = {
  id: string;
  status: RequestStatus;
  statusChangedAt: Date;
};

// Leitura de escrita: a solicitação do escopo, com o setor travado (FOR SHARE)
// e ativo. Sem isso, a falha esperada.
async function loadForWrite(
  tx: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  id: string,
): Promise<{ row: RequestRow } | { failure: AdminFailure }> {
  const row = await findRequestById(tx, actor, id);
  if (!row) return { failure: fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE) };
  const owner = await lockSectorShare(tx, actor, row.sectorId);
  if (!owner) return { failure: fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE) };
  if (!owner.active) {
    return {
      failure: fail("SECTOR_INACTIVE", SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE),
    };
  }
  return { row };
}

// O UPDATE condicionado ao status que a pessoa viu não achou linha: alguém
// chegou antes. Relê com FOR UPDATE e diz quem e quando.
async function lostRace(
  tx: Db,
  id: string,
  to: RequestStatus,
): Promise<AdminFailure> {
  const current = await lockRequest(tx, id);
  if (!current) return fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
  const last = await lastChange(tx, id);
  const byName = last?.byName ?? "outra pessoa";
  const at = last?.at ?? current.statusChangedAt;
  if (current.status === to) {
    return fail(
      "NO_CHANGES",
      to === "cancelled"
        ? alreadyCancelledMessage(byName, at)
        : alreadyMovedMessage(to, byName, at),
    );
  }
  return fail(
    "STATUS_CONFLICT",
    statusConflictMessage(current.status, byName, at),
  );
}

async function changeStatus(
  tx: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: { id: string; from: RequestStatus; to: RequestStatus },
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminFailure | { eventId: string }> {
  const updated = await tx
    .update(request)
    .set({ status: input.to, statusChangedAt: now })
    .where(and(eq(request.id, input.id), eq(request.status, input.from)))
    .returning({ id: request.id });
  if (updated.length === 0) return lostRace(tx, input.id, input.to);

  const [event] = await tx
    .insert(requestStatusEvent)
    .values({
      requestId: input.id,
      fromStatus: input.from,
      toStatus: input.to,
      changedBy: actor.userId,
      changedAt: now,
    })
    .returning({ id: requestStatusEvent.id });
  if (!event) throw new Error("changeStatus: evento não criado");
  return { eventId: event.id };
}

/** Mover (inclui reabrir): `UPDATE … WHERE status = from` + evento, na mesma transação. */
export async function moveRequest(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: MoveRequestInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult<MovedRequest>> {
  return runInTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const loaded = await loadForWrite(tx, actor, input.id);
    if ("failure" in loaded) return loaded.failure;
    if (input.from === input.to) {
      return fail("NO_CHANGES", sameStatusMessage(input.to));
    }
    const changed = await changeStatus(tx, actor, input, now);
    if ("ok" in changed) return changed;
    return ok({ id: input.id, status: input.to, statusChangedAt: now });
  });
}

/** Cancelar: o mesmo caminho, com o motivo gravado como comentário ligado ao evento. */
export async function cancelRequest(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: CancelRequestInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult<MovedRequest>> {
  return runInTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const loaded = await loadForWrite(tx, actor, input.id);
    if ("failure" in loaded) return loaded.failure;
    if (input.from === "cancelled") {
      return fail("NO_CHANGES", sameStatusMessage("cancelled"));
    }
    const changed = await changeStatus(
      tx,
      actor,
      { id: input.id, from: input.from, to: "cancelled" },
      now,
    );
    if ("ok" in changed) return changed;
    await tx.insert(requestComment).values({
      requestId: input.id,
      authorId: actor.userId,
      body: input.reason,
      createdAt: now,
      statusEventId: changed.eventId,
    });
    return ok({ id: input.id, status: "cancelled", statusChangedAt: now });
  });
}
```

```ts
"use server";

import type { AdminResult } from "@/features/admin/result";
import { runAction } from "@/features/admin/runAction";
import { type CreatedRequest, createRequest } from "@/features/requests/create";
import {
  cancelRequest,
  type MovedRequest,
  moveRequest,
} from "@/features/requests/move";
import {
  cancelRequestSchema,
  createRequestSchema,
  moveRequestSchema,
} from "@/features/requests/schemas";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";

export async function createRequestAction(
  input: unknown,
): Promise<AdminResult<CreatedRequest>> {
  const actor = await requireUser();
  return runAction({
    actor,
    schema: createRequestSchema,
    input,
    revalidate: "/(app)",
    run: ({ db, now, actor: who, input: data }) =>
      createRequest(db, who, data, now),
  });
}

export async function moveRequestAction(
  input: unknown,
): Promise<AdminResult<MovedRequest>> {
  const actor = await requireUser();
  return runAction({
    actor,
    schema: moveRequestSchema,
    input,
    revalidate: "/(app)",
    run: ({ db, now, actor: who, input: data }) =>
      moveRequest(db, who, data, now),
  });
}

export async function cancelRequestAction(
  input: unknown,
): Promise<AdminResult<MovedRequest>> {
  const actor = await requireUser();
  return runAction({
    actor,
    schema: cancelRequestSchema,
    input,
    revalidate: "/(app)",
    run: ({ db, now, actor: who, input: data }) =>
      cancelRequest(db, who, data, now),
  });
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, count, desc, eq, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";

import { user } from "@/db/schema/auth";
import { request, requestComment } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { type AdminResult, fail, ok } from "@/features/admin/result";
import { runInTransaction } from "@/features/admin/transaction";
import { type Authz, canAccessSector } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE } from "@/features/handovers/messages";

import { canDeleteComment } from "./access";
import { findRequestById, lockSectorShare } from "./loaders";
import {
  CANCEL_REASON_LOCKED_MESSAGE,
  COMMENT_DELETE_FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE,
  COMMENT_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE,
  REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE,
} from "./messages";
import type { AddCommentInput, DeleteCommentInput } from "./schemas";
import type { RequestCommentsPage } from "./types";

export type AddedComment = { id: string; createdAt: Date };

/** Qualquer pessoa do setor (e o admin) comenta; setor inativo é só leitura. */
export async function addComment(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: AddCommentInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult<AddedComment>> {
  return runInTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const row = await findRequestById(tx, actor, input.requestId);
    if (!row) return fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
    const owner = await lockSectorShare(tx, actor, row.sectorId);
    if (!owner) return fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
    if (!owner.active) {
      return fail("SECTOR_INACTIVE", SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE);
    }

    const [created] = await tx
      .insert(requestComment)
      .values({
        requestId: row.id,
        authorId: actor.userId,
        body: input.body,
        createdAt: now,
      })
      .returning({
        id: requestComment.id,
        createdAt: requestComment.createdAt,
      });
    if (!created) throw new Error("addComment: comentário não criado");
    return ok({ id: created.id, createdAt: created.createdAt });
  });
}

/**
 * Só o autor apaga o próprio comentário (o admin também só o próprio), nunca o
 * motivo de um cancelamento. É `UPDATE … SET deleted_at`, uma vez: o texto
 * fica no banco.
 */
export async function deleteComment(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: DeleteCommentInput,
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return runInTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const [found] = await tx
      .select({
        authorId: requestComment.authorId,
        statusEventId: requestComment.statusEventId,
        deletedAt: requestComment.deletedAt,
        sectorId: request.sectorId,
      })
      .from(requestComment)
      .innerJoin(request, eq(request.id, requestComment.requestId))
      .where(eq(requestComment.id, input.id));
    // Inexistente, já apagado ou de outro setor: a mesma resposta.
    if (
      !found ||
      found.deletedAt !== null ||
      !canAccessSector(actor, found.sectorId)
    ) {
      return fail("NOT_FOUND", COMMENT_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
    }
    const owner = await lockSectorShare(tx, actor, found.sectorId);
    if (!owner) return fail("NOT_FOUND", COMMENT_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
    if (!owner.active) {
      return fail("SECTOR_INACTIVE", SECTOR_INACTIVE_HANDOVER_MESSAGE);
    }
    if (found.statusEventId !== null) {
      return fail("FORBIDDEN", CANCEL_REASON_LOCKED_MESSAGE);
    }
    if (found.authorId !== actor.userId) {
      return fail("FORBIDDEN", COMMENT_DELETE_FORBIDDEN_MESSAGE);
    }

    const updated = await tx
      .update(requestComment)
      .set({ deletedAt: now })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(requestComment.id, input.id),
          eq(requestComment.authorId, actor.userId),
          isNull(requestComment.deletedAt),
          isNull(requestComment.statusEventId),
        ),
      )
      .returning({ id: requestComment.id });
    if (updated.length === 0) {
      return fail("NOT_FOUND", COMMENT_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
    }
    return ok();
  });
}

/**
 * Comentários não apagados: os últimos `limit` (created_at desc, id desc),
 * devolvidos em ordem cronológica. `total` e `hasEarlier` saem do SQL.
 */
export async function listRequestComments(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: { requestId: string; limit: number; sectorActive: boolean },
): Promise<RequestCommentsPage> {
  const visible = and(
    eq(requestComment.requestId, input.requestId),
    isNull(requestComment.deletedAt),
  );
  const [totals] = await db
    .select({ total: count() })
    .from(requestComment)
    .where(visible);
  const total = totals?.total ?? 0;

  const latest = await db
    .select({
      id: requestComment.id,
      authorId: requestComment.authorId,
      authorName: user.name,
      body: requestComment.body,
      createdAt: requestComment.createdAt,
      statusEventId: requestComment.statusEventId,
      deletedAt: requestComment.deletedAt,
    })
    .from(requestComment)
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, requestComment.authorId))
    .where(visible)
    .orderBy(desc(requestComment.createdAt), desc(requestComment.id))
    .limit(input.limit);

  const rows = latest.reverse().map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    authorName: row.authorName,
    body: row.body,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    isCancelReason: row.statusEventId !== null,
    canDelete: canDeleteComment(actor, row, { active: input.sectorActive }),
  }));
  return { rows, total, hasEarlier: total > rows.length, limit: input.limit };
}
```

```ts
  insertSector,
  insertShift,
  insertUser,
} from "../../../test/fixtures";
import { getRequestDetail, listRequestTimeline } from "./detail";
import { timelineSentence } from "./timeline";

const NIL_ID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000";
const T0 = spDate("2026-11-18", "09:00");
const HOUR = 3_600_000;

describe("detalhe da solicitação", () => {
  let client: PGlite;
  let db: TestDb;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await client.close();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await resetDb(client);
  });

  async function setup() {
    const uld = await insertSector(db, "ULD");
    const outro = await insertSector(db, "Rede de proteção");
    const ana = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: uld.id,
      name: "Ana Teste",
    });
    const bia = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: uld.id,
      name: "Bia Teste",
    });
    const caio = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: outro.id,
      name: "Caio Teste",
    });
    const admin = await insertUser(db, { role: "admin", sectorId: null });
    return {
      uld,
      outro,
      ana,
      bia,
      anaAuthz: authzOf({
        role: "operator",
        userId: ana.id,
        sectorId: uld.id,
        name: "Ana Teste",
      }),
      caioAuthz: authzOf({
        role: "operator",
        userId: caio.id,
        sectorId: outro.id,
      }),
      adminAuthz: authzOf({ role: "admin", userId: admin.id }),
    };
  }

  const detailOf = async (
    actor: ReturnType<typeof authzOf>,
    id: string,
    now = T0,
    commentsLimit = 50,
  ) => {
    const result = await getRequestDetail(
      db,
      actor,
      { id, commentsLimit },
      now,
    );
    if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`getRequestDetail falhou: ${result.code}`);
    return result.detail;
  };

  describe("getRequestDetail", () => {
    it("propriedades com destino da lista, quem criou e o setor", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const doca = await insertDestination(db, { name: "Doca 3" });
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationId: doca.id,
        description: "Repor fita\ncom urgência",
        createdAt: T0,
      });

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id);

      expect(detail).toMatchObject({
        id: created.id,
        sectorId: uld.id,
        sectorName: "ULD",
        sectorActive: true,
        description: "Repor fita\ncom urgência",
        destinationName: "Doca 3",
        destinationIsOther: false,
        status: "requested",
        createdByName: "Ana Teste",
        createdAt: T0,
        statusChangedAt: T0,
        origin: null,
        items: [],
      });
    });

    it("destino 'Outro' mostra o texto digitado", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        destinationOther: "Hangar 7",
      });

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id);

      expect(detail).toMatchObject({
        destinationName: "Hangar 7",
        destinationIsOther: true,
      });
    });

    it("origem: usa o nome do turno gravado na entrega; sem ele, o nome vivo", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const turno = await insertShift(db, { sectorId: uld.id, name: "Dia" });
      const entregue = await insertHandover(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        shiftId: turno.id,
        operationalDate: "2026-11-18",
        status: "delivered",
        deliveredBy: ana.id,
        shiftNameSnapshot: "Turno Dia (antigo)",
      });
      const rascunho = await insertHandover(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        shiftId: turno.id,
        operationalDate: "2026-11-19",
      });
      const comSnapshot = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        originHandoverId: entregue.id,
      });
      const semSnapshot = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        originHandoverId: rascunho.id,
      });

      expect((await detailOf(anaAuthz, comSnapshot.id)).origin).toEqual({
        handoverId: entregue.id,
        shiftName: "Turno Dia (antigo)",
        operationalDate: "2026-11-18",
      });
      expect((await detailOf(anaAuthz, semSnapshot.id)).origin).toEqual({
        handoverId: rascunho.id,
        shiftName: "Dia",
        operationalDate: "2026-11-19",
      });
    });

    it("itens vêm dos snapshots (renomear o item depois não muda) na ordem do cadastro", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const segundo = await insertItem(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        name: "Lacre numerado",
        unit: "caixa",
        kind: "stock",
        sortOrder: 2,
      });
      const primeiro = await insertItem(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        name: "Fita adesiva",
        unit: "rolo",
        kind: "stock",
        sortOrder: 1,
      });
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
      });
      await insertRequestItem(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        itemId: segundo.id,
        quantity: 3,
      });
      await insertRequestItem(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        itemId: primeiro.id,
        quantity: 12,
      });
      await db
        .update(item)
        .set({ name: "Fita larga", unit: "metro" })
        .where(eq(item.id, primeiro.id));

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id);

      expect(detail.items).toEqual([
        {
          itemId: primeiro.id,
          name: "Fita adesiva",
          unit: "rolo",
          quantity: 12,
        },
        {
          itemId: segundo.id,
          name: "Lacre numerado",
          unit: "caixa",
          quantity: 3,
        },
      ]);
    });

    it("linha do tempo com as quatro frases em ordem e o motivo junto do 'cancelou'", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, bia, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        createdAt: T0,
        statusChangedAt: new Date(T0.getTime() + 3 * HOUR),
        events: false,
      });
      const at = (hours: number) => new Date(T0.getTime() + hours * HOUR);
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: null,
        toStatus: "requested",
        changedBy: ana.id,
        changedAt: at(0),
      });
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: "requested",
        toStatus: "in_transit",
        changedBy: bia.id,
        changedAt: at(1),
      });
      const cancel = await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: "in_transit",
        toStatus: "cancelled",
        changedBy: ana.id,
        changedAt: at(2),
      });
      await insertRequestComment(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        authorId: ana.id,
        body: "Pedido duplicado",
        createdAt: at(2),
        statusEventId: cancel.id,
      });
      await insertRequestEvent(db, {
        requestId: created.id,
        fromStatus: "cancelled",
        toStatus: "requested",
        changedBy: bia.id,
        changedAt: at(3),
      });

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id, at(4));

      expect(detail.timeline.map((entry) => timelineSentence(entry))).toEqual([
        "Criada por Ana Teste",
        "Bia Teste moveu para Em separação / Trânsito",
        "Ana Teste cancelou",
        "Bia Teste reabriu como Solicitada",
      ]);
      expect(detail.timeline.map((entry) => entry.reason)).toEqual([
        null,
        null,
        "Pedido duplicado",
        null,
      ]);
      expect(detail.timeline.map((entry) => entry.at)).toEqual([
        at(0),
        at(1),
        at(2),
        at(3),
      ]);
    });

    it("três eventos com o MESMO instante saem na ordem de inserção", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, bia } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        createdAt: T0,
        events: false,
      });
      const steps: [
        "requested" | "in_transit" | "delivered" | null,
        "requested" | "in_transit" | "delivered",
        string,
      ][] = [
        [null, "requested", ana.id],
        ["requested", "in_transit", bia.id],
        ["in_transit", "delivered", ana.id],
      ];
      for (const [fromStatus, toStatus, changedBy] of steps) {
        await insertRequestEvent(db, {
          requestId: created.id,
          fromStatus,
          toStatus,
          changedBy,
          changedAt: T0,
        });
      }

      const timeline = await listRequestTimeline(db, created.id);

      expect(timeline.map((entry) => entry.to)).toEqual([
        "requested",
        "in_transit",
        "delivered",
      ]);
    });

    it("201 eventos: os 200 mais recentes, em ordem cronológica", async () => {
      const { uld, ana } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        createdAt: T0,
        events: false,
      });
      await db.insert(requestStatusEvent).values(
        Array.from({ length: 201 }, (_, index) => ({
          requestId: created.id,
          fromStatus:
            index === 0
              ? null
              : index % 2 === 1
                ? ("requested" as const)
                : ("in_transit" as const),
          toStatus:
            index % 2 === 0 ? ("requested" as const) : ("in_transit" as const),
          changedBy: ana.id,
          changedAt: new Date(T0.getTime() + index * 60_000),
        })),
      );

      const timeline = await listRequestTimeline(db, created.id);

      expect(timeline).toHaveLength(200);
      expect(timeline[0]?.at).toEqual(new Date(T0.getTime() + 60_000));
      expect(timeline.at(-1)?.at).toEqual(
        new Date(T0.getTime() + 200 * 60_000),
      );
    });

    it("dias no status e 'parada' usam o relógio injetado (72 h exatas não param; +1 ms param)", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        createdAt: T0,
      });
      const exact = new Date(T0.getTime() + 72 * HOUR);

      const atLimit = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id, exact);
      const over = await detailOf(
        anaAuthz,
        created.id,
        new Date(exact.getTime() + 1),
      );
      const fresh = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id, T0);

      expect([atLimit.daysInStatus, atLimit.stale]).toEqual([3, false]);
      expect([over.daysInStatus, over.stale]).toEqual([3, true]);
      expect([fresh.daysInStatus, fresh.stale]).toEqual([0, false]);
    });

    it("Entregue e Cancelada nunca ficam paradas", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const entregue = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        status: "delivered",
        createdAt: T0,
      });
      const longe = new Date(T0.getTime() + 400 * HOUR);

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, entregue.id, longe);

      expect(detail).toMatchObject({ stale: false, daysInStatus: 16 });
    });

    it("comentários respeitam commentsLimit e trazem o total", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
      });
      for (const body of ["a", "b", "c"]) {
        await insertRequestComment(db, {
          requestId: created.id,
          authorId: ana.id,
          body,
          createdAt: new Date(T0.getTime() + body.charCodeAt(0) * 1000),
        });
      }

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id, T0, 2);

      expect(detail.comments).toMatchObject({
        total: 3,
        hasEarlier: true,
        limit: 2,
      });
      expect(detail.comments.rows.map((row) => row.body)).toEqual(["b", "c"]);
    });
  });

  describe("permissões", () => {
    it.each([
      ["operador do setor, setor ativo", "ana", true, true, true, true],
      ["admin, setor ativo", "admin", true, true, true, true],
      ["operador do setor, setor inativo", "ana", false, true, false, false],
      ["admin, setor inativo", "admin", false, true, false, false],
    ])("%s", async (_label, who, active, canView, canMove, canComment) => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz, adminAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
      });
      if (!active) {
        await client.exec(
          `UPDATE "sector" SET "active" = false WHERE "id" = '${uld.id}'`,
        );
      }

      const detail = await detailOf(
        who === "ana" ? anaAuthz : adminAuthz,
        created.id,
      );

      expect(detail.sectorActive).toBe(active);
      expect(detail.capabilities).toEqual({
        canView,
        canMove,
        canCancel: canMove,
        canComment,
      });
    });

    it("Cancelada não oferece cancelar de novo", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        status: "cancelled",
      });

      const detail = await detailOf(anaAuthz, created.id);

      expect(detail.capabilities).toEqual({
        canView: true,
        canMove: true,
        canCancel: false,
        canComment: true,
      });
    });

    it("operador de outro setor e id inexistente: NOT_FOUND", async () => {
      const { uld, ana, caioAuthz, anaAuthz } = await setup();
      const created = await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
      });

      const stranger = await getRequestDetail(
        db,
        caioAuthz,
        { id: created.id, commentsLimit: 50 },
        T0,
      );
      const missing = await getRequestDetail(
        db,
        anaAuthz,
        { id: NIL_ID, commentsLimit: 50 },
        T0,
      );

      const expected = {
        ok: false,
        code: "NOT_FOUND",
        message: "Solicitação não encontrada. Atualize a página.",
      };
      expect(stranger).toEqual(expected);
      expect(missing).toEqual(expected);
    });
  });
});
```

Crie `src/features/requests/detail.ts`:

```ts
import "server-only";

import { asc, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { user } from "@/db/schema/auth";
import { destination, item, shift } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { handover } from "@/db/schema/handovers";
import {
  requestComment,
  requestItem,
  requestStatusEvent,
} from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { type AdminResult, fail, ok } from "@/features/admin/result";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { loadSector, userNames } from "@/features/handovers/loaders";

import { requestCapabilities } from "./access";
import { listRequestComments } from "./comments";
import { TIMELINE_LIMIT } from "./limits";
import { findRequestById } from "./loaders";
import { REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE } from "./messages";
import { daysInStatus, isStale } from "./stale";
import { timelineKind } from "./timeline";
import type {
  RequestDetailView,
  RequestItemLine,
  RequestOrigin,
  RequestTimelineEntry,
} from "./types";

/**
 * Os últimos TIMELINE_LIMIT eventos (changed_at desc, seq desc) devolvidos em
 * ordem cronológica, com o nome de quem mudou e, no cancelamento, o motivo
 * (o comentário ligado ao evento).
 */
export async function listRequestTimeline(
  db: Db,
  requestId: string,
): Promise<RequestTimelineEntry[]> {
  const latest = await db
    .select({
      id: requestStatusEvent.id,
      from: requestStatusEvent.fromStatus,
      to: requestStatusEvent.toStatus,
      byName: user.name,
      at: requestStatusEvent.changedAt,
      reason: requestComment.body,
    })
    .from(requestStatusEvent)
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, requestStatusEvent.changedBy))
    .leftJoin(
      requestComment,
      eq(requestComment.statusEventId, requestStatusEvent.id),
    )
    .where(eq(requestStatusEvent.requestId, requestId))
    .orderBy(desc(requestStatusEvent.changedAt), desc(requestStatusEvent.seq))
    .limit(TIMELINE_LIMIT);

  return latest.reverse().map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    kind: timelineKind(row.from, row.to),
    from: row.from,
    to: row.to,
    byName: row.byName,
    at: row.at,
    reason: row.reason,
  }));
}

async function loadOrigin(
  db: Db,
  handoverId: string | null,
): Promise<RequestOrigin | null> {
  if (handoverId === null) return null;
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      handoverId: handover.id,
      operationalDate: handover.operationalDate,
      snapshot: handover.shiftNameSnapshot,
      liveName: shift.name,
    })
    .from(handover)
    .innerJoin(shift, eq(shift.id, handover.shiftId))
    .where(eq(handover.id, handoverId));
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    handoverId: row.handoverId,
    shiftName: row.snapshot ?? row.liveName,
    operationalDate: row.operationalDate,
  };
}

async function loadItems(
  db: Db,
  requestId: string,
): Promise<RequestItemLine[]> {
  return db
    .select({
      itemId: requestItem.itemId,
      name: requestItem.itemNameSnapshot,
      unit: requestItem.itemUnitSnapshot,
      quantity: requestItem.quantity,
    })
    .from(requestItem)
    .innerJoin(item, eq(item.id, requestItem.itemId))
    .where(eq(requestItem.requestId, requestId))
    .orderBy(asc(item.sortOrder), asc(item.id));
}

/**
 * Tudo que o detalhe mostra, numa chamada. Fora do escopo ou inexistente:
 * NOT_FOUND. Setor inativo continua legível (capabilities de escrita false).
 */
export async function getRequestDetail(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: { id: string; commentsLimit: number },
  now: Date,
): Promise<AdminResult<{ detail: RequestDetailView }>> {
  const row = await findRequestById(db, actor, input.id);
  if (!row) return fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);
  const owner = await loadSector(db, actor, row.sectorId);
  if (!owner) return fail("NOT_FOUND", REQUEST_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE);

  let destinationName = row.destinationOther ?? "";
  if (row.destinationId !== null) {
    const [target] = await db
      .select({ name: destination.name })
      .from(destination)
      .where(eq(destination.id, row.destinationId));
    destinationName = target?.name ?? "";
  }
  const names = await userNames(db, [row.createdBy]);

  const [origin, items, timeline, comments] = await Promise.all([
    loadOrigin(db, row.originHandoverId),
    loadItems(db, row.id),
    listRequestTimeline(db, row.id),
    listRequestComments(db, actor, {
      requestId: row.id,
      limit: input.commentsLimit,
      sectorActive: owner.active,
    }),
  ]);

  return ok({
    detail: {
      id: row.id,
      sectorId: owner.id,
      sectorName: owner.name,
      sectorActive: owner.active,
      description: row.description,
      destinationName,
      destinationIsOther: row.destinationId === null,
      status: row.status,
      createdByName: names.get(row.createdBy) ?? "",
      createdAt: row.createdAt,
      statusChangedAt: row.statusChangedAt,
      daysInStatus: daysInStatus(row.statusChangedAt, now),
      stale: isStale(row.status, row.statusChangedAt, now),
      origin,
      items,
      timeline,
      comments,
      capabilities: requestCapabilities(actor, row, owner),
    },
  });
}
```

```ts
});
```
