```ts
import type { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { request } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import { REQUEST_STATUSES } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { createTestDb, resetDb, type TestDb } from "../../../test/db";
import {
  insertRequest,
  insertSector,
  insertUser,
} from "../../../test/fixtures";
import { daysInStatusSql, staleSql } from "./sql";
import { daysInStatus, isStale } from "./stale";

// "Parada" e "dias no status" são calculados no SQL (contagens, ordem, status
// na entrega) e no JS (stale.ts, telas). Os dois têm de concordar em toda a
// grade abaixo, nas bordas de 72 h.
const NOW = new Date("2026-11-21T15:00:00.000Z");
const HOUR = 3_600_000;
const MINUTE = 60_000;

// Quanto tempo antes de NOW o status mudou (negativo = no futuro).
const AGES: readonly [string, number][] = [
  ["1 h no futuro", -HOUR],
  ["agora", 0],
  ["1 ms", 1],
  ["23 h 59", 24 * HOUR - MINUTE],
  ["24 h", 24 * HOUR],
  ["71 h 59", 72 * HOUR - MINUTE],
  ["72 h exatas", 72 * HOUR],
  ["72 h + 1 ms", 72 * HOUR + 1],
  ["96 h", 96 * HOUR],
  ["30 dias", 30 * 24 * HOUR],
];

let client: PGlite;
let db: TestDb;

beforeAll(async () => {
  ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await client.close();
});

describe("paridade stale.ts × SQL", () => {
  it("daysInStatusSql e staleSql batem com daysInStatus e isStale em toda a grade", async () => {
    await resetDb(client);
    const sector = await insertSector(db);
    const author = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: sector.id,
    });

    const cases: {
      id: string;
      label: string;
      status: (typeof REQUEST_STATUSES)[number];
      changedAt: Date;
    }[] = [];
    for (const status of REQUEST_STATUSES) {
      for (const [label, age] of AGES) {
        const changedAt = new Date(NOW.getTime() - age);
        const { id } = await insertRequest(db, {
          sectorId: sector.id,
          createdBy: author.id,
          status,
          createdAt: changedAt,
          statusChangedAt: changedAt,
          events: false,
        });
        cases.push({ id, label, status, changedAt });
      }
    }
    expect(cases).toHaveLength(REQUEST_STATUSES.length * AGES.length);

    for (const { id, label, status, changedAt } of cases) {
      const [row] = await db
        .select({
          days: daysInStatusSql(NOW, request.statusChangedAt),
          stale: staleSql(NOW, request.status, request.statusChangedAt),
        })
        .from(request)
        .where(eq(request.id, id));
      expect(row, `${status} / ${label}`).toEqual({
        days: daysInStatus(changedAt, NOW),
        stale: isStale(status, changedAt, NOW),
      });
    }
  });

  it("as bordas conhecidas: 72 h exatas não é parada (3 dias); 72 h + 1 ms é; futuro é 0 dia", async () => {
    await resetDb(client);
    const sector = await insertSector(db);
    const author = await insertUser(db, {
      role: "operator",
      sectorId: sector.id,
    });
    const at = (age: number) => new Date(NOW.getTime() - age);
    const exact = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: author.id,
      createdAt: at(72 * HOUR),
      events: false,
    });
    const over = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: author.id,
      createdAt: at(72 * HOUR + 1),
      events: false,
    });
    const future = await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: sector.id,
      createdBy: author.id,
      createdAt: at(-HOUR),
      events: false,
    });

    const read = async (id: string) => {
      const [row] = await db
        .select({
          days: daysInStatusSql(NOW, request.statusChangedAt),
          stale: staleSql(NOW, request.status, request.statusChangedAt),
        })
        .from(request)
        .where(eq(request.id, id));
      return row;
    };
    expect(await read(exact.id)).toEqual({ days: 3, stale: false });
    expect(await read(over.id)).toEqual({ days: 3, stale: true });
    expect(await read(future.id)).toEqual({ days: 0, stale: false });
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { createTestDb, type TestDb } from "../../../test/db";
import { foldForSearch, SEARCH_FOLD_FROM, SEARCH_FOLD_TO } from "./search";
import { foldSql } from "./sql";

// A busca dobra acento e caixa no SQL (foldSql) e a URL é dobrada no JS
// (foldForSearch): o padrão ILIKE só acha o que o SQL guardou se os dois
// fizerem a mesma conta. Palavras sempre em NFC (o domínio grava em NFC).
const WORDS = [
  "separação rápida",
  "SEPARAÇÃO RÁPIDA",
  "Água",
  "ÁGUA",
  "Pão de Queijo",
  "AÇÃO",
  "Ñandú",
  "ÀÉÎÕÜ",
  "Doca 3",
  "100% (urgente) _ \\",
  "sem acento nenhum",
  "😀 emoji",
  "",
  ...Array.from(SEARCH_FOLD_FROM),
  ...Array.from(SEARCH_FOLD_FROM).map((letter) => letter.toUpperCase()),
];

let client: PGlite;
let db: TestDb;

beforeAll(async () => {
  ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await client.close();
});

describe("paridade search.ts × SQL", () => {
  it("os dois alfabetos de dobra têm o mesmo tamanho", () => {
    expect(Array.from(SEARCH_FOLD_FROM)).toHaveLength(24);
    expect(Array.from(SEARCH_FOLD_TO)).toHaveLength(24);
  });

  it("foldSql devolve o mesmo que foldForSearch para cada palavra", async () => {
    for (const word of WORDS) {
      const [row] = await db
        .select({ folded: foldSql(sql`${word}::text`) })
        .from(sql`(values (1)) as one(n)`);
      expect(row?.folded, JSON.stringify(word)).toBe(foldForSearch(word));
    }
  });

  it("separação rápida vira separacao rapida nos dois", async () => {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ folded: foldSql(sql`${"SEPARAÇÃO Rápida"}::text`) })
      .from(sql`(values (1)) as one(n)`);
    expect(row?.folded).toBe("separacao rapida");
    expect(foldForSearch("SEPARAÇÃO Rápida")).toBe("separacao rapida");
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation — `sql.ts`**

Crie `src/features/requests/sql.ts`. Os fragmentos usam **colunas obrigatórias** (sem padrão implícito em `request.*`): a seção "na entrega" da passagem calcula sobre o evento daquele instante, e um padrão silencioso contaria sobre o status de agora.

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, eq, isNull, type SQL, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { PgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

import { request } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import { type Authz, isAdmin } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { scopeToSector } from "@/features/authz/sectorScope";
import { SAO_PAULO_TIME_ZONE } from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";

import { DESTINATION_OTHER, STALE_AFTER_DAYS } from "./limits";
import type { RequestFilters } from "./requestFilters";
import { SEARCH_FOLD_FROM, SEARCH_FOLD_TO, searchPattern } from "./search";

// Fragmentos de SQL das leituras de solicitação. As colunas de tempo e status
// são parâmetros OBRIGATÓRIOS: a seção "na entrega" da passagem calcula sobre
// o evento daquele instante, e um padrão silencioso (request.*) calcularia
// sobre o status de agora.
export function daysInStatusSql(
  now: Date,
  changedAt: SQL | PgColumn,
): SQL<number> {
  return sql<number>`greatest(0, floor(extract(epoch from (${now.toISOString()}::timestamptz - ${changedAt})) / 86400))::int`;
}

export function staleSql(
  now: Date,
  status: SQL | PgColumn,
  changedAt: SQL | PgColumn,
): SQL<boolean> {
  return sql<boolean>`(${status} in ('requested', 'in_transit') and ${now.toISOString()}::timestamptz - ${changedAt} > make_interval(days => ${sql.raw(String(STALE_AFTER_DAYS))}))`;
}

// Espelho SQL de foldForSearch (search.ts): translate(lower(x), FROM, TO).
export function foldSql(column: SQL | PgColumn): SQL<string> {
  return sql<string>`translate(lower(${column}), ${SEARCH_FOLD_FROM}, ${SEARCH_FOLD_TO})`;
}

// `pattern` vem de searchPattern (já dobrado e com \, % e _ escapados); o
// escape padrão do ILIKE é a barra invertida. Pede o JOIN com `destination`.
export function searchSql(pattern: string): SQL {
  return sql`(${foldSql(sql`"request"."description"`)} ilike ${pattern} or ${foldSql(sql`"destination"."name"`)} ilike ${pattern} or ${foldSql(sql`"request"."destination_other"`)} ilike ${pattern})`;
}

// Dia de São Paulo em que a solicitação foi criada, entre duas datas "YYYY-MM-DD".
export function createdBetweenSql(from: string, to: string): SQL {
  return sql`(("request"."created_at" at time zone ${SAO_PAULO_TIME_ZONE})::date between ${from}::date and ${to}::date)`;
}

// Escopo de setor (operador preso ao próprio; o `sectorId` dele é ignorado) +
// setor escolhido (admin) + setor ativo. Coluna externa por extenso na
// subconsulta correlata (library-docs §5).
export function requestScopeSql(actor: Authz, sectorId: string | null): SQL {
  const condition = and(
    scopeToSector(actor, request.sectorId),
    isAdmin(actor) && sectorId !== null
      ? eq(request.sectorId, sectorId)
      : undefined,
    sql`exists (select 1 from "sector" where "sector"."id" = "request"."sector_id" and "sector"."active")`,
  );
  return condition ?? sql`true`;
}

// Destino, período, criador e busca. Pede o JOIN com `destination`.
export function requestFilterSql(filters: RequestFilters): SQL | undefined {
  const pattern = searchPattern(filters.search);
  return and(
    filters.destination === null
      ? undefined
      : filters.destination === DESTINATION_OTHER
        ? isNull(request.destinationId)
        : eq(request.destinationId, filters.destination),
    filters.period !== "all" && filters.from !== null && filters.to !== null
      ? createdBetweenSql(filters.from, filters.to)
      : undefined,
    filters.creatorId === null
      ? undefined
      : eq(request.createdBy, filters.creatorId),
    pattern === null ? undefined : searchSql(pattern),
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Write minimal implementation — `lists.ts`**

Um `SELECT` só com `count(*) filter (where …)` dá os 4 totais sobre o mesmo recorte (a janela de 30 dias entra só no filtro de Entregue e Cancelada e só em "Todo o período"); depois uma consulta por status com `LIMIT filters.limits[status]`. A Tabela faz a contagem e a página sobre o mesmo recorte e não aplica a janela.

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, asc, desc, eq, type SQL, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { user } from "@/db/schema/auth";
import { destination } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { request } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import { sector } from "@/db/schema/sectors";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { PAGE_SIZE, type Page, resolvePage } from "@/features/admin/pagination";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { REQUEST_STATUSES, type RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { CLOSED_WINDOW_DAYS, DAY_MS } from "./limits";
import type { RequestFilters } from "./requestFilters";
import {
  daysInStatusSql,
  requestFilterSql,
  requestScopeSql,
  staleSql,
} from "./sql";
import { isOpenStatus } from "./status";
import type { RequestGroups, RequestListItem } from "./types";

type ListQuery = { sectorId: string | null; filters: RequestFilters };

// Tudo que a linha mostra é calculado aqui, no SQL: dias, "parada" e as
// contagens de itens e de comentários (sem os apagados).
function listColumns(now: Date) {
  return {
    id: request.id,
    sectorId: request.sectorId,
    sectorName: sector.name,
    description: request.description,
    destinationName: sql<string>`coalesce(${destination.name}, ${request.destinationOther})`,
    destinationIsOther: sql<boolean>`(${request.destinationId} is null)`,
    status: request.status,
    createdByName: user.name,
    createdAt: request.createdAt,
    statusChangedAt: request.statusChangedAt,
    daysInStatus: daysInStatusSql(now, request.statusChangedAt),
    stale: staleSql(now, request.status, request.statusChangedAt),
    itemCount:
      sql<number>`(select count(*) from "request_item" where "request_item"."request_id" = "request"."id")`.mapWith(
        Number,
      ),
    commentCount:
      sql<number>`(select count(*) from "request_comment" where "request_comment"."request_id" = "request"."id" and "request_comment"."deleted_at" is null)`.mapWith(
        Number,
      ),
  };
}

function recorte(actor: Authz, query: ListQuery): SQL | undefined {
  return and(
    requestScopeSql(actor, query.sectorId),
    requestFilterSql(query.filters),
  );
}

// Entregue e Cancelada só dos últimos 30 dias (por status_changed_at) quando
// nenhum período foi escolhido; as abertas nunca saem pela janela.
function windowSql(filters: RequestFilters, now: Date): SQL | undefined {
  if (filters.period !== "all") return undefined;
  const cutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - CLOSED_WINDOW_DAYS * DAY_MS);
  return sql`"request"."status_changed_at" >= ${cutoff.toISOString()}::timestamptz`;
}

function groupWhere(
  actor: Authz,
  query: ListQuery,
  status: RequestStatus,
  now: Date,
): SQL | undefined {
  return and(
    recorte(actor, query),
    eq(request.status, status),
    isOpenStatus(status) ? undefined : windowSql(query.filters, now),
  );
}

export async function getRequestGroups(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: ListQuery,
  now: Date,
): Promise<RequestGroups> {
  const window = windowSql(input.filters, now) ?? sql`true`;
  const count = (status: RequestStatus) =>
    isOpenStatus(status)
      ? sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${request.status} = ${status})`
      : sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${request.status} = ${status} and ${window})`;

  const [totals] = await db
    .select({
      requested: count("requested").mapWith(Number),
      in_transit: count("in_transit").mapWith(Number),
      delivered: count("delivered").mapWith(Number),
      cancelled: count("cancelled").mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(request)
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(recorte(actor, input));

  const rowsOf = async (status: RequestStatus): Promise<RequestListItem[]> => {
    const order = isOpenStatus(status)
      ? [asc(request.statusChangedAt), asc(request.id)]
      : [desc(request.statusChangedAt), desc(request.id)];
    return db
      .select(listColumns(now))
      .from(request)
      .innerJoin(sector, eq(sector.id, request.sectorId))
      .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, request.createdBy))
      .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
      .where(groupWhere(actor, input, status, now))
      .orderBy(...order)
      .limit(input.filters.limits[status]);
  };

  const [requested, inTransit, delivered, cancelled] = await Promise.all(
    REQUEST_STATUSES.map(rowsOf),
  );
  const rows: Record<RequestStatus, RequestListItem[]> = {
    requested: requested ?? [],
    in_transit: inTransit ?? [],
    delivered: delivered ?? [],
    cancelled: cancelled ?? [],
  };

  const group = (status: RequestStatus) => ({
    status,
    total: totals?.[status] ?? 0,
    limit: input.filters.limits[status],
    rows: rows[status],
  });
  return {
    requested: group("requested"),
    in_transit: group("in_transit"),
    delivered: group("delivered"),
    cancelled: group("cancelled"),
  };
}

// A Tabela é o arquivo: todos os status, sem a janela de 30 dias, do mais
// novo para o mais antigo, PAGE_SIZE por página.
export async function listRequestTable(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: ListQuery,
  now: Date,
): Promise<Page<RequestListItem>> {
  const where = recorte(actor, input);

  const [counted] = await db
    .select({ total: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number) })
    .from(request)
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(where);
  const total = counted?.total ?? 0;
  const { page, pageCount, offset } = resolvePage(total, input.filters.page);

  const rows = await db
    .select(listColumns(now))
    .from(request)
    .innerJoin(sector, eq(sector.id, request.sectorId))
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, request.createdBy))
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(desc(request.createdAt), desc(request.id))
    .limit(PAGE_SIZE)
    .offset(offset);

  return { rows, total, page, pageCount, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write minimal implementation — `choices.ts`**

Itens por setor com `row_number() over (partition by sector_id order by sort_order, created_at, id)` e corte em 200 (subconsulta nomeada, sem `db.execute`); destino mais usado com `GROUP BY` e `DISTINCT ON (sector_id)`; quem criou com `GROUP BY` (um `SELECT DISTINCT` com `ORDER BY lower(name)` o PostgreSQL recusa: "for SELECT DISTINCT, ORDER BY expressions must appear in select list").

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, asc, desc, eq, inArray, lte, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { user } from "@/db/schema/auth";
import { destination, item } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { request } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { CHOICE_LIST_LIMIT } from "@/features/admin/pagination";
import type { Authz } from "@/features/authz/authz";

import { requestScopeSql } from "./sql";
import type {
  DestinationChoice,
  FilterDestination,
  PersonChoice,
  RequestFormChoices,
  StockItemChoice,
} from "./types";

// Destinos para CRIAR: só os ativos.
export async function listActiveDestinations(
  db: Db,
): Promise<DestinationChoice[]> {
  return db
    .select({ id: destination.id, name: destination.name })
    .from(destination)
    .where(eq(destination.active, true))
    .orderBy(sql`lower(${destination.name})`, asc(destination.id))
    .limit(CHOICE_LIST_LIMIT);
}

// Destinos para FILTRAR: todos (solicitações antigas usam os inativos).
export async function listFilterDestinations(
  db: Db,
): Promise<FilterDestination[]> {
  return db
    .select({
      id: destination.id,
      name: destination.name,
      active: destination.active,
    })
    .from(destination)
    .orderBy(
      desc(destination.active),
      sql`lower(${destination.name})`,
      asc(destination.id),
    )
    .limit(CHOICE_LIST_LIMIT);
}

// Itens de ESTOQUE ativos de cada setor, na ordem do setor, até 200 por setor
// (`row_number() over (partition by sector_id …)`).
export async function listRequestStockItems(
  db: Db,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, StockItemChoice[]>> {
  const result = new Map<string, StockItemChoice[]>();
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return result;

  const ranked = db
    .select({
      id: item.id,
      sectorId: item.sectorId,
      name: item.name,
      unit: item.unit,
      rank: sql<number>`row_number() over (partition by ${item.sectorId} order by ${item.sortOrder}, ${item.createdAt}, ${item.id})`
        .mapWith(Number)
        .as("rank"),
    })
    .from(item)
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(item.sectorId, [...sectorIds]),
        eq(item.kind, "stock"),
        eq(item.active, true),
      ),
    )
    .as("ranked");

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: ranked.id,
      sectorId: ranked.sectorId,
      name: ranked.name,
      unit: ranked.unit,
    })
    .from(ranked)
    .where(lte(ranked.rank, CHOICE_LIST_LIMIT))
    .orderBy(asc(ranked.sectorId), asc(ranked.rank));

  for (const row of rows) {
    const list = result.get(row.sectorId) ?? [];
    list.push({ id: row.id, name: row.name, unit: row.unit });
    result.set(row.sectorId, list);
  }
  return result;
}

// Setor → destino ATIVO mais usado nas solicitações dele (contagem desc, uso
// mais recente desc, id). Setor sem histórico não entra no mapa.
export async function mostUsedDestinations(
  db: Db,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const result = new Map<string, string>();
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return result;

  const usage = db
    .select({
      sectorId: request.sectorId,
      destinationId: destination.id,
      uses: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number).as("uses"),
      lastUsed: sql`max(${request.createdAt})`.as("last_used"),
    })
    .from(request)
    .innerJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(request.sectorId, [...sectorIds]),
        eq(destination.active, true),
      ),
    )
    .groupBy(request.sectorId, destination.id)
    .as("usage");

  const rows = await db
    .selectDistinctOn([usage.sectorId], {
      sectorId: usage.sectorId,
      destinationId: usage.destinationId,
    })
    .from(usage)
    .orderBy(
      asc(usage.sectorId),
      desc(usage.uses),
      desc(usage.lastUsed),
      asc(usage.destinationId),
    );

  for (const row of rows) result.set(row.sectorId, row.destinationId);
  return result;
}

// F4-21: destinos ativos uma vez e, por setor, os itens de estoque e o destino
// padrão (o mais usado; sem histórico, o primeiro ativo; sem ativos, null =
// "Outro"). Ids vazios: só os destinos.
export async function getRequestFormChoices(
  db: Db,
  sectorIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<RequestFormChoices> {
  const destinations = await listActiveDestinations(db);
  if (sectorIds.length === 0) return { destinations, bySector: {} };

  const [stock, mostUsed] = await Promise.all([
    listRequestStockItems(db, sectorIds),
    mostUsedDestinations(db, sectorIds),
  ]);
  const fallback = destinations[0]?.id ?? null;
  const bySector: RequestFormChoices["bySector"] = {};
  for (const sectorId of sectorIds) {
    bySector[sectorId] = {
      stockItems: stock.get(sectorId) ?? [],
      defaultDestinationId: mostUsed.get(sectorId) ?? fallback,
    };
  }
  return { destinations, bySector };
}

// Quem criou solicitações no escopo (setor escolhido ou todos; só setores
// ativos), SEM aplicar os outros filtros.
export async function listRequestCreators(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  sectorId: string | null,
): Promise<PersonChoice[]> {
  return db
    .select({ id: user.id, name: user.name })
    .from(request)
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, request.createdBy))
    .where(requestScopeSql(actor, sectorId))
    .groupBy(user.id, user.name)
    .orderBy(sql`lower(${user.name})`, asc(user.id))
    .limit(CHOICE_LIST_LIMIT);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 15: Write minimal implementation — `open.ts`**

`listOpenRequestsAtDelivery` monta a CTE `last` com `selectDistinctOn([request_id])` ordenada por `request_id, changed_at desc, seq desc` (o último evento até T) e filtra "aberta" na consulta externa. As colunas da CTE (`last.changedAt`, `last.toStatus`) já trazem o decoder de `timestamptz` do schema; por isso nada aqui precisa de `.mapWith(requestStatusEvent.changedAt)` (só seria necessário se a função devolvesse o instante cru dentro de um `sql<…>`, o que ela não faz). O `isOpenStatus` no `flatMap` estreita `OpenStatus` sem `as`.

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, asc, desc, eq, inArray, lte, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { destination } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { request, requestStatusEvent } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { type Authz, canAccessSector } from "@/features/authz/authz";

import { HANDOVER_OPEN_LIMIT } from "./limits";
import { daysInStatusSql, requestScopeSql, staleSql } from "./sql";
import { isOpenStatus, OPEN_STATUSES } from "./status";
import type {
  OpenRequestSummary,
  OpenRequestsAtDelivery,
  OpenRequestsNow,
  RequestAtDelivery,
} from "./types";

// "Solicitações abertas" do formulário da passagem: as abertas AGORA do setor
// (Solicitada e Em separação / Trânsito), as paradas há mais tempo primeiro.
// Fora do escopo ou setor inativo: vazio.
export async function listOpenRequests(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  sectorId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<OpenRequestsNow> {
  const empty: OpenRequestsNow = { rows: [], total: 0, staleCount: 0 };
  if (!canAccessSector(actor, sectorId)) return empty;

  const where = and(
    requestScopeSql(actor, sectorId),
    inArray(request.status, [...OPEN_STATUSES]),
  );
  const stale = staleSql(now, request.status, request.statusChangedAt);

  const [counted] = await db
    .select({
      total: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number),
      staleCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${stale})`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(request)
    .where(where);

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: request.id,
      description: request.description,
      destinationName: sql<string>`coalesce(${destination.name}, ${request.destinationOther})`,
      status: request.status,
      daysInStatus: daysInStatusSql(now, request.statusChangedAt),
      stale,
    })
    .from(request)
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(asc(request.statusChangedAt), asc(request.id))
    .limit(HANDOVER_OPEN_LIMIT);

  return {
    rows: rows.flatMap((row): OpenRequestSummary[] =>
      isOpenStatus(row.status) ? [{ ...row, status: row.status }] : [],
    ),
    total: counted?.total ?? 0,
    staleCount: counted?.staleCount ?? 0,
  };
}

// "Solicitações abertas" do resumo da passagem (D-F4-2): as que estavam
// abertas NO INSTANTE da entrega, com o status daquele instante (último
// evento com changed_at <= deliveredAt) e o de agora ao lado.
//
// O filtro "aberta" fica na consulta EXTERNA, nunca dentro do DISTINCT ON:
// dentro dele, uma solicitação entregue antes de T devolveria o último evento
// ABERTO dela. Não junta `sector.active`: o resumo de um setor inativo
// continua legível.
export async function listOpenRequestsAtDelivery(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  input: { sectorId: string; deliveredAt: Date },
): Promise<OpenRequestsAtDelivery> {
  const { sectorId, deliveredAt } = input;
  const empty: OpenRequestsAtDelivery = {
    deliveredAt,
    rows: [],
    total: 0,
    staleCount: 0,
  };
  if (!canAccessSector(actor, sectorId)) return empty;

  // Último evento de cada solicitação do setor até o instante T. Ordem total:
  // changed_at, seq (nunca id).
  const last = db.$with("last").as(
    db
      .selectDistinctOn([requestStatusEvent.requestId], {
        requestId: requestStatusEvent.requestId,
        toStatus: requestStatusEvent.toStatus,
        changedAt: requestStatusEvent.changedAt,
      })
      .from(requestStatusEvent)
      .innerJoin(request, eq(request.id, requestStatusEvent.requestId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(request.sectorId, sectorId),
          lte(requestStatusEvent.changedAt, deliveredAt),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(
        asc(requestStatusEvent.requestId),
        desc(requestStatusEvent.changedAt),
        desc(requestStatusEvent.seq),
      ),
  );
  const openAtDelivery = inArray(last.toStatus, [...OPEN_STATUSES]);
  const stale = staleSql(deliveredAt, last.toStatus, last.changedAt);

  const [counted] = await db
    .with(last)
    .select({
      total: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number),
      staleCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${stale})`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(last)
    .where(openAtDelivery);

  const rows = await db
    .with(last)
    .select({
      id: request.id,
      description: request.description,
      destinationName: sql<string>`coalesce(${destination.name}, ${request.destinationOther})`,
      status: last.toStatus,
      daysInStatus: daysInStatusSql(deliveredAt, last.changedAt),
      stale,
      statusNow: request.status,
    })
    .from(last)
    .innerJoin(request, eq(request.id, last.requestId))
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(openAtDelivery)
    .orderBy(asc(last.changedAt), asc(request.id))
    .limit(HANDOVER_OPEN_LIMIT);

  return {
    deliveredAt,
    rows: rows.flatMap((row): RequestAtDelivery[] =>
      isOpenStatus(row.status) ? [{ ...row, status: row.status }] : [],
    ),
    total: counted?.total ?? 0,
    staleCount: counted?.staleCount ?? 0,
  };
}
```

```ts
let otherId: string;
let anaId: string;
let docaId: string;
let operator: Authz;
let admin: Authz;

beforeAll(async () => {
  ({ client, db } = await createTestDb());
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await client.close();
});

beforeEach(async () => {
  await resetDb(client);
  sectorId = (await insertSector(db)).id;
  otherId = (await insertSector(db)).id;
  anaId = (await insertUser(db, { role: "operator", sectorId })).id;
  docaId = (await insertDestination(db, { name: "Doca 3" })).id;
  operator = authzOf({ role: "operator", userId: anaId, sectorId });
  admin = authzOf({ role: "admin" });
});

function seed(overrides: Partial<Parameters<typeof insertRequest>[1]> = {}) {
  return insertRequest(db, {
    sectorId,
    createdBy: anaId,
    destinationId: docaId,
    createdAt: ago(HOUR),
    ...overrides,
  });
}

describe("getHomeRequests", () => {
  it("sem solicitações: zeros", async () => {
    expect(await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW)).toEqual({
      openCount: 0,
      staleCount: 0,
      stale: [],
    });
  });

  it("conta as abertas e as paradas; fechadas não entram", async () => {
    await seed({ description: "recente" });
    const stale = await seed({
      description: "parada",
      status: "in_transit",
      createdAt: ago(6 * DAY),
      statusChangedAt: ago(4 * DAY),
    });
    await seed({
      status: "delivered",
      createdAt: ago(9 * DAY),
      statusChangedAt: ago(8 * DAY),
    });
    await seed({
      status: "cancelled",
      createdAt: ago(9 * DAY),
      statusChangedAt: ago(8 * DAY),
    });

    const result = await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW);

    expect(result.openCount).toBe(2);
    expect(result.staleCount).toBe(1);
    expect(result.stale).toEqual([
      {
        id: stale.id,
        description: "parada",
        destinationName: "Doca 3",
        status: "in_transit",
        daysInStatus: 4,
        stale: true,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("até 5 paradas, as mais antigas no status primeiro; a contagem é de todas", async () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < HOME_STALE_LIMIT + 3; i++) {
      await seed({
        description: `Parada ${i}`,
        createdAt: ago(10 * DAY - i * HOUR),
        events: false,
      });
    }

    const result = await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW);

    expect(result.openCount).toBe(8);
    expect(result.staleCount).toBe(8);
    expect(result.stale).toHaveLength(HOME_STALE_LIMIT);
    expect(result.stale.map((row) => row.description)).toEqual([
      "Parada 0",
      "Parada 1",
      "Parada 2",
      "Parada 3",
      "Parada 4",
    ]);
  });

  it("72 h exatas não é parada; 72 h + 1 ms é", async () => {
    await seed({ createdAt: ago(72 * HOUR), events: false });
    expect(
      (await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW)).staleCount,
    ).toBe(0);

    await seed({ createdAt: ago(72 * HOUR + 1), events: false });
    expect(
      (await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW)).staleCount,
    ).toBe(1);
  });

  it("só o setor pedido; operador de outro setor recebe zeros; admin lê qualquer um", async () => {
    await seed();
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: otherId,
      createdBy: anaId,
      destinationOther: "Em outro setor",
      createdAt: ago(HOUR),
    });

    expect((await getHomeRequests(db, operator, sectorId, NOW)).openCount).toBe(
      1,
    );
    expect(await getHomeRequests(db, operator, otherId, NOW)).toEqual({
      openCount: 0,
      staleCount: 0,
      stale: [],
    });
    expect((await getHomeRequests(db, admin, otherId, NOW)).openCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it("setor inativo: zeros", async () => {
    const inactive = await insertSector(db, "Inativo", { active: false });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: inactive.id,
      createdBy: anaId,
      destinationOther: "Qualquer",
      createdAt: ago(HOUR),
    });

    expect(await getHomeRequests(db, admin, inactive.id, NOW)).toEqual({
      openCount: 0,
      staleCount: 0,
      stale: [],
    });
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 19: Write minimal implementation — `home.ts`**

```ts
import "server-only";

import { and, asc, eq, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { destination } from "@/db/schema/catalog";
import { request } from "@/db/schema/requests";
import type { Db } from "@/db/types";
import { type Authz, canAccessSector } from "@/features/authz/authz";

import { HOME_STALE_LIMIT } from "./limits";
import { daysInStatusSql, requestScopeSql, staleSql } from "./sql";
import { isOpenStatus, OPEN_STATUSES } from "./status";
import type { HomeRequests, OpenRequestSummary } from "./types";

// Cartão "Solicitações" do Início: quantas abertas, quantas paradas e as
// paradas há mais tempo (até HOME_STALE_LIMIT). Contagens do SQL.
export async function getHomeRequests(
  db: Db,
  actor: Authz,
  sectorId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<HomeRequests> {
  const empty: HomeRequests = { openCount: 0, staleCount: 0, stale: [] };
  if (!canAccessSector(actor, sectorId)) return empty;

  const open = and(
    requestScopeSql(actor, sectorId),
    inArray(request.status, [...OPEN_STATUSES]),
  );
  const stale = staleSql(now, request.status, request.statusChangedAt);

  const [counted] = await db
    .select({
      openCount: sql<number>`count(*)`.mapWith(Number),
      staleCount: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${stale})`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(request)
    .where(open);

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: request.id,
      description: request.description,
      destinationName: sql<string>`coalesce(${destination.name}, ${request.destinationOther})`,
      status: request.status,
      daysInStatus: daysInStatusSql(now, request.statusChangedAt),
      stale,
    })
    .from(request)
    .leftJoin(destination, eq(destination.id, request.destinationId))
    .where(and(open, stale))
    .orderBy(asc(request.statusChangedAt), asc(request.id))
    .limit(HOME_STALE_LIMIT);

  return {
    openCount: counted?.openCount ?? 0,
    staleCount: counted?.staleCount ?? 0,
    stale: rows.flatMap((row): OpenRequestSummary[] =>
      isOpenStatus(row.status) ? [{ ...row, status: row.status }] : [],
    ),
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation — `stepQuantity`**

Leia `src/features/handovers/quantity.ts` e troque só a função `stepQuantity` (o resto do arquivo fica):

Trecho atual:

```ts
/** Soma ou subtrai 1; trava em 0 e em MAX_QUANTITY. */
export function stepQuantity(value: number, delta: 1 | -1): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value + delta, 0), MAX_QUANTITY);
}
```

Novo trecho:

```ts
/** Soma ou subtrai 1; trava em `min` (padrão 0) e em MAX_QUANTITY. */
export function stepQuantity(value: number, delta: 1 | -1, min = 0): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value + delta, min), MAX_QUANTITY);
}
```

```tsx
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { useState } from "react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { QuantityCounter } from "./QuantityCounter";

const LABEL = "Luva";

// Contador com mínimo 1, como o das linhas de item da solicitação.
function setup(props: { initial?: number; min?: number } = {}) {
  const onChange = vi.fn();
  const onCommit = vi.fn();
  function Harness() {
    const [value, setValue] = useState(props.initial ?? 1);
    return (
      <TooltipProvider>
        <QuantityCounter
          label={LABEL}
          unit="par"
          value={value}
          min={props.min}
          onChange={(next) => {
            setValue(next);
            onChange(next);
          }}
          onCommit={onCommit}
        />
      </TooltipProvider>
    );
  }
  render(<Harness />);
  return { onChange, onCommit };
}

const input = () =>
  screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: `Quantidade de ${LABEL}` });
const minus = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: `Diminuir ${LABEL}` });
const plus = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: `Aumentar ${LABEL}` });

describe("QuantityCounter com min={1}", () => {
  it("− fica desativado no mínimo e + continua funcionando", async () => {
    const { onChange } = setup({ initial: 1, min: 1 });

    expect(minus()).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.click(minus());
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await userEvent.click(plus());
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("2");
    expect(minus()).toBeEnabled();
  });

  it("− para no mínimo, nunca abaixo", async () => {
    setup({ initial: 2, min: 1 });

    await userEvent.click(minus());
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("1");
    expect(minus()).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("campo vazio ao sair volta ao mínimo e esse valor é salvo", async () => {
    const { onChange, onCommit } = setup({ initial: 4, min: 1 });

    await userEvent.clear(input());
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("");
    expect(onCommit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await userEvent.tab();

    expect(input()).toHaveValue("1");
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(1);
    expect(onCommit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(onCommit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1);
  });

  it("digitar 0 fica só no campo (não chama onChange) e ao sair vira o mínimo", async () => {
    const { onChange, onCommit } = setup({ initial: 4, min: 1 });

    await userEvent.click(input());
    await userEvent.keyboard("0");
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("0");
    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await userEvent.tab();

    expect(input()).toHaveValue("1");
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(1);
    expect(onCommit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1);
  });

  it("digitar um valor válido acima do mínimo chama onChange na hora", async () => {
    const { onChange } = setup({ initial: 1, min: 1 });

    await userEvent.click(input());
    await userEvent.keyboard("12");

    expect(input()).toHaveValue("12");
    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(12);
  });
});

describe("QuantityCounter sem min", () => {
  it("o padrão continua 0: − desativado só em 0 e campo vazio vira 0", async () => {
    setup({ initial: 1 });

    expect(minus()).toBeEnabled();
    await userEvent.click(minus());
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("0");
    expect(minus()).toBeDisabled();

    await userEvent.clear(input());
    await userEvent.tab();
    expect(input()).toHaveValue("0");
  });
});
```

```tsx
        expect(text).not.toMatch(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/);
      }
      unmount();
    }
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Write minimal implementation — `statusStyle.ts`**

```ts
import {
  CircleCheck,
  CircleDot,
  CircleX,
  type LucideIcon,
  Truck,
} from "lucide-react";

import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

// Ícone e cor de cada status (a cor pertence ao status e nunca é ciclada).
// `buttonClass` é a cor do botão que MOVE PARA o status: o mesmo token do selo,
// mais borda transparente e o hover do próprio token. Classes sempre inteiras
// no texto, para o Tailwind enxergá-las. O botão de cancelar usa
// variant="destructive", não este mapa.
export const REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE: Readonly<
  Record<
    RequestStatus,
    { icon: LucideIcon; badgeClass: string; buttonClass: string }
  >
> = {
  requested: {
    icon: CircleDot,
    badgeClass: "bg-info text-info-foreground",
    buttonClass:
      "bg-info text-info-foreground border-transparent hover:bg-info/80",
  },
  in_transit: {
    icon: Truck,
    badgeClass: "bg-warning text-warning-foreground",
    buttonClass:
      "bg-warning text-warning-foreground border-transparent hover:bg-warning/80",
  },
  delivered: {
    icon: CircleCheck,
    badgeClass: "bg-success text-success-foreground",
    buttonClass:
      "bg-success text-success-foreground border-transparent hover:bg-success/80",
  },
  cancelled: {
    icon: CircleX,
    badgeClass: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
    buttonClass:
      "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent hover:bg-muted/80",
  },
};
```

`src/components/solicitacoes/RequestStatusBadge.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL } from "@/features/requests/status";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE } from "./statusStyle";

// Status sempre com ícone e texto, nunca só cor.
export function RequestStatusBadge({ status }: { status: RequestStatus }) {
  const { icon: Icon, badgeClass } = REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE[status];
  return (
    <Badge variant="secondary" className={`h-6 ${badgeClass}`}>
      <Icon aria-hidden="true" />
      {REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[status]}
    </Badge>
  );
}
```

`src/components/solicitacoes/StaleBadge.tsx`:

```tsx
import { ClockAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { staleLabel } from "@/features/requests/stale";

// "Parada há N dias": ícone e texto, nunca só cor.
export function StaleBadge({ days }: { days: number }) {
  return (
    <Badge
      variant="secondary"
      className="h-6 bg-warning text-warning-foreground"
    >
      <ClockAlert aria-hidden="true" />
      {staleLabel(days)}
    </Badge>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { fail, ok } from "@/features/admin/result";
import type { HandoverRef } from "@/features/handovers/types";
import {
  DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED_MESSAGE,
  DESCRIPTION_TOO_LONG_MESSAGE,
  DESTINATION_INACTIVE_MESSAGE,
  DESTINATION_OTHER_REQUIRED_MESSAGE,
  ORIGIN_LOCKED_MESSAGE,
} from "@/features/requests/messages";
import type { RequestFormChoices } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { RequestForm } from "./RequestForm";

const SECTOR_A = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
const SECTOR_B = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";
const DOCA = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa";
const BALCAO = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb";
const LUVA = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc";
const FITA = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd";
const COLA = "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee";
const CREATED_ID = "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff";

const CHOICES: RequestFormChoices = {
  destinations: [
    { id: BALCAO, name: "Balcão" },
    { id: DOCA, name: "Doca 3" },
  ],
  bySector: {
    [SECTOR_A]: {
      stockItems: [
        { id: LUVA, name: "Luva", unit: "par" },
        { id: FITA, name: "Fita", unit: "rolo" },
      ],
      defaultDestinationId: DOCA,
    },
    [SECTOR_B]: {
      stockItems: [
        { id: FITA, name: "Fita", unit: "rolo" },
        { id: COLA, name: "Cola", unit: "frasco" },
      ],
      defaultDestinationId: BALCAO,
    },
  },
};

const NO_DESTINATIONS: RequestFormChoices = {
  destinations: [],
  bySector: {
    [SECTOR_A]: { stockItems: [], defaultDestinationId: null },
  },
};

const REF: HandoverRef = {
  sectorId: SECTOR_A,
  shiftId: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
  operationalDate: "2026-11-20",
};

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createRequestAction: vi.fn(),
  toastSuccess: vi.fn(),
  toastError: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock("@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions", () => ({
  createRequestAction: mocks.createRequestAction,
}));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({
  toast: { success: mocks.toastSuccess, error: mocks.toastError },
}));

function setup(
  props: {
    choices?: RequestFormChoices;
    sectors?: { id: string; name: string }[] | null;
    initialSectorId?: string;
    originRef?: HandoverRef | null;
  } = {},
) {
  const onCreated = vi.fn();
  const onCancel = vi.fn();
  render(
    <TooltipProvider>
      <RequestForm
        sectors={props.sectors ?? null}
        initialSectorId={props.initialSectorId ?? SECTOR_A}
        choices={props.choices ?? CHOICES}
        originRef={props.originRef ?? null}
        onCreated={onCreated}
        onCancel={onCancel}
      />
    </TooltipProvider>,
  );
  return { onCreated, onCancel };
}

const destination = () => screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Destino" });
const description = () => screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Descrição" });
const submit = () =>
  screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^Criar solicitação$|^Criando…$/ });
const addItem = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Adicionar item" });
const itemSelects = () => screen.queryAllByRole("combobox", { name: "Item" });
const optionNames = (select: HTMLElement) =>
  Array.from(select.querySelectorAll("option")).map((o) => o.textContent);

function hover(element: HTMLElement) {
  fireEvent.pointerEnter(element, { pointerType: "mouse" });
  fireEvent.mouseEnter(element);
  fireEvent.pointerMove(element, { pointerType: "mouse" });
  fireEvent.mouseMove(element);
}

describe("RequestForm", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    for (const mock of Object.values(mocks)) mock.mockReset();
  });

  describe("nunca começa em branco", () => {
    it("o destino já vem escolhido: o padrão do setor; 'Outro' é a última opção", () => {
      setup();

      expect(destination()).toHaveValue(DOCA);
      expect(optionNames(destination())).toEqual(["Balcão", "Doca 3", "Outro"]);
      expect(screen.queryByLabelText("Qual destino?")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(description()).toHaveValue("");
      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(submit()).toHaveTextContent("Criar solicitação");
    });

    it("sem destinos ativos o padrão é 'Outro' e o campo 'Qual destino?' já aparece", () => {
      setup({ choices: NO_DESTINATIONS });

      expect(optionNames(destination())).toEqual(["Outro"]);
      expect(screen.getByLabelText("Qual destino?")).toHaveValue("");
    });

    it("escolher 'Outro' revela 'Qual destino?' e voltar para a lista o esconde", async () => {
      setup();

      await userEvent.selectOptions(destination(), "outro");
      expect(screen.getByLabelText("Qual destino?")).toBeInTheDocument();

      await userEvent.selectOptions(destination(), BALCAO);
      expect(screen.queryByLabelText("Qual destino?")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("operador (sem campo Setor) não vê o seletor de setor", () => {

      expect(

      ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe("itens", () => {
    it("'Adicionar item' acrescenta o primeiro item ainda não escolhido com quantidade 1", async () => {

      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(itemSelects()[0]).toHaveValue(LUVA);
      expect(
        screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Quantidade de Luva" }),
      ).toHaveValue("1");
      expect(screen.getByText("par")).toBeInTheDocument();

      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(itemSelects()[1]).toHaveValue(FITA);
    });

    it("cada linha oferece só os itens que ninguém escolheu (e o próprio); o botão desativa quando acabam", async () => {
      setup();

      await userEvent.click(addItem());

      const [first, second] = itemSelects();

      expect(addItem()).toBeDisabled();

    it("trocar o item da linha mantém a quantidade", async () => {
      setup();
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      await userEvent.click(
        screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Aumentar Luva" }),
      );
      expect(
        screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Quantidade de Luva" }),

      await userEvent.selectOptions(itemSelects()[0] as HTMLElement, FITA);

      expect(itemSelects()[0]).toHaveValue(FITA);
      expect(
        screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Quantidade de Fita" }),

    it("a quantidade tem mínimo 1: − desativado em 1", async () => {

      await userEvent.click(

      expect(

    it("remover tem aria-label, tooltip e tira a linha (o item volta a ficar disponível)", async () => {
      setup();
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      const remove = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Remover Luva" });

      hover(remove);
      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(screen.getByText("Remover item")).toBeInTheDocument(),
      );
      await userEvent.click(remove);

      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(addItem()).toBeEnabled();
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      expect(itemSelects()[0]).toHaveValue(LUVA);
    });

    it("setor sem itens de estoque mostra o texto e não oferece 'Adicionar item'", () => {
      setup({ choices: NO_DESTINATIONS });

      expect(
        screen.getByText("Nenhum item de estoque neste setor."),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(
        screen.queryByRole("button", { name: "Adicionar item" }),
      ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe("admin", () => {
    const SECTORS = [
      { id: SECTOR_A, name: "Almoxarifado Teste" },
      { id: SECTOR_B, name: "Outro Setor" },
    ];

    it("trocar o setor limpa os itens, troca a lista de itens e mantém o destino", async () => {
      setup({ sectors: SECTORS });
      expect(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Setor" })).toHaveValue(
        SECTOR_A,
      );
      await userEvent.selectOptions(destination(), BALCAO);
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(1);

      await userEvent.selectOptions(
        screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Setor" }),
        SECTOR_B,
      );

      expect(itemSelects()).toHaveLength(0);
      expect(destination()).toHaveValue(BALCAO);
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      expect(itemSelects()[0]).toHaveValue(FITA);
      await userEvent.click(addItem());
      expect(itemSelects()[1]).toHaveValue(COLA);
    });

    it("manda o setor escolhido", async () => {
      mocks.createRequestAction.mockResolvedValue(ok({ id: CREATED_ID }));
      setup({ sectors: SECTORS });

        screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Setor" }),
        SECTOR_B,
      );
      await userEvent.type(description(), "Cola para a doca");
      await userEvent.click(submit());

      await waitFor(() =>
        expect(mocks.createRequestAction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1),
      );
      expect(mocks.createRequestAction.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).toMatchObject({
        sectorId: SECTOR_B,

        destinationId: DOCA,

  });

  describe("validação antes de chamar a action", () => {
    it("descrição vazia: erro no campo e a action não é chamada", async () => {

    });

  it("'Voltar' chama onCancel sem tocar na action", async () => {
    const { onCancel } = setup();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Voltar" }));

    expect(mocks.createRequestAction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

  it("campos digitáveis com text-base e alvos de 44px no celular", () => {

    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Qual destino?")).toHaveClass("text-base");
    expect(submit().className).toContain("max-md:h-11");

});
```

- [ ] **Step 16: Write minimal implementation — `RequestForm.tsx`**

Estado `{ sectorId, destinationId, destinationOther, description, items }` (nunca em branco: `destinationId` nasce em `choices.bySector[initialSectorId].defaultDestinationId ?? "outro"`). Valida com `createRequestSchema.safeParse(payload)` antes da action; `useAdminAction().run(..., { showError: false, success: "Solicitação criada." })`. O erro do servidor vai para `fieldErrors`; se nenhum dos campos que têm onde mostrar o erro foi atingido (ex.: `HANDOVER_LOCKED` da origem confirmada, sem `fieldErrors`), a mensagem vai para um `FieldError` no pé do formulário. O botão ícone de remover é um componente local com tooltip e `aria-label`.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { type FormEvent, useId, useState } from "react";

import { createRequestAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import { SelectField } from "@/components/admin/SelectField";
import { useAdminAction } from "@/components/admin/useAdminAction";
import { QuantityCounter } from "@/components/passagens/QuantityCounter";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSet,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  NativeSelect,
  NativeSelectOption,
} from "@/components/ui/native-select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import type { FieldErrors } from "@/features/admin/result";
import { firstFieldErrors } from "@/features/admin/schemas";
import type { SectorChoice } from "@/features/admin/sectors";
import type { HandoverRef } from "@/features/handovers/types";
import {
  DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH,
  DESTINATION_OTHER,
  DESTINATION_OTHER_MAX_LENGTH,
  REQUEST_ITEM_MIN_QUANTITY,
} from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { createRequestSchema } from "@/features/requests/schemas";
import type {
  RequestFormChoices,
  RequestItemInput,
  SectorFormChoices,
  StockItemChoice,
} from "@/features/requests/types";

// Campos que têm onde mostrar o erro; qualquer outro vira o erro do pé.
const FORM_FIELDS = [
  "sectorId",
  "destinationId",
  "destinationOther",
  "description",
  "items",
] as const;

const NO_SECTOR_CHOICES: SectorFormChoices = {
  stockItems: [],
  defaultDestinationId: null,
};

// Formulário de nova solicitação (F4-9). O MESMO na tela de solicitações e na
// passagem. Nunca começa em branco: o destino já vem escolhido (o mais usado
// do setor) e cada item entra com quantidade 1. Valida com o schema do
// servidor antes de chamar a action; o erro do servidor vai para o campo certo
// e nada do que foi digitado se perde.
export function RequestForm({
  sectors,
  initialSectorId,
  choices,
  originRef,
  onCreated,
  onCancel,
}: {
  sectors: readonly SectorChoice[] | null;
  initialSectorId: string;
  choices: RequestFormChoices;
  originRef: HandoverRef | null;
  onCreated: (id: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const uid = useId();
  const { pending, run } = useAdminAction();
  const [sectorId, setSectorId] = useState(initialSectorId);
  const [destinationId, setDestinationId] = useState<string>(
    () =>
      choices.bySector[initialSectorId]?.defaultDestinationId ??
      DESTINATION_OTHER,
  );
  const [destinationOther, setDestinationOther] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [items, setItems] = useState<RequestItemInput[]>([]);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>({});
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const sectorChoices = choices.bySector[sectorId] ?? NO_SECTOR_CHOICES;
  const stockById = new Map<string, StockItemChoice>(
    sectorChoices.stockItems.map((stock) => [stock.id, stock]),
  );
  const chosenIds = new Set(items.map((line) => line.itemId));
  const nextItem = sectorChoices.stockItems.find(
    (stock) => !chosenIds.has(stock.id),
  );
  const isOther = destinationId === DESTINATION_OTHER;
  const destinationOptions = [
    ...choices.destinations.map((option) => ({
      value: option.id,
      label: option.name,
    })),
    { value: DESTINATION_OTHER, label: "Outro" },
  ];

  function changeSector(next: string) {
    // Os itens são do setor: trocar de setor limpa a lista e mantém o destino.
    setSectorId(next);
    setItems([]);
  }

  function addItem() {
    if (!nextItem) return;
    setItems((current) => [
      ...current,
      { itemId: nextItem.id, quantity: REQUEST_ITEM_MIN_QUANTITY },
    ]);
  }

  function replaceItem(index: number, itemId: string) {
    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((line, at) => (at === index ? { ...line, itemId } : line)),
    );
  }

  function setQuantity(index: number, quantity: number) {
    setItems((current) =>
      current.map((line, at) => (at === index ? { ...line, quantity } : line)),
    );
  }

  function removeItem(index: number) {
    setItems((current) => current.filter((_, at) => at !== index));
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    setFieldErrors({});
    setFormError(null);

    const payload = {
      sectorId,
      destinationId: isOther ? null : destinationId,
      destinationOther: isOther ? destinationOther : "",
      description,
      items,
      originRef,
    };
    const parsed = createRequestSchema.safeParse(payload);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      setFieldErrors(firstFieldErrors(parsed.error));
      return;
    }

    const result = await run(() => createRequestAction(payload), {
      showError: false,
      success: "Solicitação criada.",
    });
    if (result.ok) {
      onCreated(result.id);
      return;
    }
    const errors = result.fieldErrors ?? {};
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    const shownInField = FORM_FIELDS.some((field) => errors[field]);
    setFormError(shownInField ? null : result.message);
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
      <FieldGroup>
        {sectors !== null && (
          <SelectField
            id={`${uid}-sector`}
            label="Setor"
            value={sectorId}
            onValueChange={changeSector}
            options={sectors.map((sector) => ({
              value: sector.id,
              label: sector.name,
            }))}
            error={fieldErrors.sectorId}
            disabled={pending}
          />
        )}

        <SelectField
          id={`${uid}-destination`}
          label="Destino"
          value={destinationId}
          onValueChange={setDestinationId}
          options={destinationOptions}
          error={fieldErrors.destinationId}
          disabled={pending}
        />

        {isOther && (
          <Field data-invalid={fieldErrors.destinationOther ? true : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${uid}-other`}>Qual destino?</FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${uid}-other`}
              type="text"
              autoComplete="off"
              className="text-base md:text-base"
              maxLength={DESTINATION_OTHER_MAX_LENGTH}
              value={destinationOther}
              disabled={pending}
              aria-invalid={fieldErrors.destinationOther ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby={
                fieldErrors.destinationOther ? `${uid}-other-error` : undefined
              }
              onChange={(event) => setDestinationOther(event.target.value)}
            />
            {fieldErrors.destinationOther && (
              <FieldError id={`${uid}-other-error`}>
                {fieldErrors.destinationOther}
              </FieldError>
            )}
          </Field>
        )}

        <Field data-invalid={fieldErrors.description ? true : undefined}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${uid}-description`}>Descrição</FieldLabel>
          <Textarea
            id={`${uid}-description`}
            maxLength={DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH}
            value={description}
            disabled={pending}
            aria-invalid={fieldErrors.description ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={`${uid}-description-help${
              fieldErrors.description ? ` ${uid}-description-error` : ""
            }`}
            onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
          />
          <FieldDescription id={`${uid}-description-help`}>
            Obrigatória. O que precisa e para quando.
          </FieldDescription>
          {fieldErrors.description && (
            <FieldError id={`${uid}-description-error`}>
              {fieldErrors.description}
            </FieldError>
          )}
        </Field>

        <FieldSet>
          <FieldLegend variant="label">Itens</FieldLegend>
          <FieldDescription>
            Opcional. Itens de estoque do setor.
          </FieldDescription>
          {sectorChoices.stockItems.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Nenhum item de estoque neste setor.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <>
              {items.length > 0 && (
                <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                  {items.map((line, index) => {
                    const stock = stockById.get(line.itemId);
                    const name = stock?.name ?? "Item";
                    const options = sectorChoices.stockItems.filter(
                      (option) =>
                        option.id === line.itemId || !chosenIds.has(option.id),
                    );
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={line.itemId}
                        className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center"
                      >
                        <NativeSelect
                          className="w-full sm:flex-1"
                          aria-label="Item"
                          value={line.itemId}
                          disabled={pending}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            replaceItem(index, event.target.value)
                          }
                        >
                          {options.map((option) => (
                            <NativeSelectOption
                              key={option.id}
                              value={option.id}
                            >
                              {option.name}
                            </NativeSelectOption>
                          ))}
                        </NativeSelect>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <QuantityCounter
                            label={name}
                            unit={stock?.unit ?? ""}
                            value={line.quantity}
                            min={REQUEST_ITEM_MIN_QUANTITY}
                            disabled={pending}
                            onChange={(quantity) =>
                              setQuantity(index, quantity)
                            }
                          />
                          <RemoveItemButton
                            name={name}
                            disabled={pending}
                            onClick={() => removeItem(index)}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </li>
                    );
                  })}
                </ul>
              )}
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                className="w-fit"
                disabled={pending || !nextItem}
                onClick={addItem}
              >
                <Plus aria-hidden="true" />
                Adicionar item
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
          {fieldErrors.items && <FieldError>{fieldErrors.items}</FieldError>}
        </FieldSet>

        {formError && <FieldError>{formError}</FieldError>}

        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={onCancel}
          >
            Voltar
          </Button>
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>
            {pending ? "Criando…" : "Criar solicitação"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </FieldGroup>
    </form>
  );
}

// Controle só com ícone: tooltip e aria-label.
function RemoveItemButton({
  name,
  disabled,
  onClick,
}: {
  name: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger
        render={
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon"
            aria-label={`Remover ${name}`}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={onClick}
          />
        }
      >
        <Trash2 aria-hidden="true" />
      </TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent>Remover item</TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { render, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { TooltipProvider } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { fail, ok } from "@/features/admin/result";
import type { RequestFormChoices } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { NewRequestDialog } from "./NewRequestDialog";

const SECTOR = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
const DOCA = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa";
const CREATED_ID = "ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff";

const CHOICES: RequestFormChoices = {
  destinations: [{ id: DOCA, name: "Doca 3" }],
  bySector: { [SECTOR]: { stockItems: [], defaultDestinationId: DOCA } },
};

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createRequestAction: vi.fn(),
  toastSuccess: vi.fn(),
  toastError: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock("@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions", () => ({
  createRequestAction: mocks.createRequestAction,
}));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({
  toast: { success: mocks.toastSuccess, error: mocks.toastError },
}));

function setup(triggerVariant?: "default" | "outline") {
  render(
    <TooltipProvider>
      <NewRequestDialog
        sectors={null}
        initialSectorId={SECTOR}
        choices={CHOICES}
        originRef={null}
        triggerVariant={triggerVariant}
      />
    </TooltipProvider>,
  );
}

const trigger = () => screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Nova solicitação" });
const dialog = () => screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Nova solicitação" });
const description = () =>
  within(dialog()).getByRole("textbox", { name: "Descrição" });

describe("NewRequestDialog", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    for (const mock of Object.values(mocks)) mock.mockReset();
  });

  it("começa fechado; o gatilho abre o diálogo com título, descrição e o formulário", async () => {
    setup();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    await userEvent.click(trigger());

    expect(dialog()).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(dialog()).getByText(
        "Ela entra como Solicitada. A equipe do setor move o status até a entrega.",
      ),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(dialog()).getByRole("button", { name: "Criar solicitação" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    // O X do primitivo fica desligado: "Voltar" é o jeito de fechar.
    expect(
      within(dialog()).queryByRole("button", { name: "Fechar" }),
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("sucesso: fecha o diálogo e mostra o toast 'Solicitação criada.'", async () => {
    mocks.createRequestAction.mockResolvedValue(ok({ id: CREATED_ID }));
    setup();

    await userEvent.click(trigger());
    await userEvent.type(description(), "Luvas para a doca");
    await userEvent.click(
      within(dialog()).getByRole("button", { name: "Criar solicitação" }),
    );

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).not.toBeInTheDocument(),
    );
    expect(mocks.toastSuccess).toHaveBeenCalledWith("Solicitação criada.");
    expect(mocks.createRequestAction).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("erro: o diálogo continua aberto, com a mensagem e o texto digitado", async () => {
    mocks.createRequestAction.mockResolvedValue(
      fail(
        "SECTOR_INACTIVE",
        "Este setor está inativo. Peça a um administrador para reativá-lo.",
      ),
    );
    setup();

    await userEvent.click(trigger());
    await userEvent.type(description(), "Luvas para a doca");
    await userEvent.click(
      within(dialog()).getByRole("button", { name: "Criar solicitação" }),
    );

    expect(
      await within(dialog()).findByText(
        "Este setor está inativo. Peça a um administrador para reativá-lo.",
      ),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(description()).toHaveValue("Luvas para a doca");
  });

  it("'Voltar' fecha sem chamar a action e a próxima abertura começa do zero", async () => {
    setup();

    await userEvent.click(trigger());
    await userEvent.type(description(), "Rascunho que será descartado");
    await userEvent.click(
      within(dialog()).getByRole("button", { name: "Voltar" }),
    );
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).not.toBeInTheDocument(),
    );
    expect(mocks.createRequestAction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await userEvent.click(trigger());

    expect(description()).toHaveValue("");
    expect(
      within(dialog()).getByRole("combobox", { name: "Destino" }),
    ).toHaveValue(DOCA);
  });

  it("o gatilho aceita a variante outline (usada dentro da passagem)", () => {
    setup("outline");

    expect(trigger().className).toContain("border-border");
  });
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import type { SectorChoice } from "@/features/admin/sectors";
import type { HandoverRef } from "@/features/handovers/types";
import type { RequestFormChoices } from "@/features/requests/types";

import { RequestForm } from "./RequestForm";

// Gatilho "Nova solicitação" + diálogo com o RequestForm. O conteúdo desmonta
// ao fechar, então cada abertura começa com o estado novo (destino padrão,
// descrição vazia, sem itens). "Voltar" fecha; o X do primitivo fica desligado
// porque um botão só com ícone precisaria de tooltip (padrão do ConfirmDialog).
export function NewRequestDialog({
  sectors,
  initialSectorId,
  choices,
  originRef,
  triggerVariant = "default",
}: {
  sectors: readonly SectorChoice[] | null;
  initialSectorId: string;
  choices: RequestFormChoices;
  originRef: HandoverRef | null;
  triggerVariant?: "default" | "outline";
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button type="button" variant={triggerVariant} />}>
        <Plus aria-hidden="true" />
        Nova solicitação
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent
        showCloseButton={false}
        className="max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-lg"
      >
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Nova solicitação</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Ela entra como Solicitada. A equipe do setor move o status até a
            entrega.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <RequestForm
          sectors={sectors}
          initialSectorId={initialSectorId}
          choices={choices}
          originRef={originRef}
          onCreated={() => setOpen(false)}
          onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
        />
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

Componentes de domínio — \`src/features/<domínio>/components\`` insira o bloco abaixo, com uma linha em branco antes do `## 3.` (ele cria a seção "Solicitações" e as 5 entradas):

```markdown
### Solicitações — `src/components/solicitacoes/*` (Fase 4)

Selos, formulário de criação, quadro, lista, tabela e detalhe das solicitações. Status sempre com ícone e texto (a cor pertence ao status e nunca é ciclada); ação que muda status usa a cor do status de destino.

### statusStyle
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
- **Local:** `src/components/solicitacoes/statusStyle.ts` (server-safe)
- **Propósito:** o ícone e as classes de cor de cada status de solicitação, num lugar só.
- **Como funciona:** `REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE[status]` devolve `{ icon, badgeClass, buttonClass }`. Solicitada `CircleDot` + `bg-info text-info-foreground`; Em separação / Trânsito `Truck` + `bg-warning text-warning-foreground`; Entregue `CircleCheck` + `bg-success text-success-foreground`; Cancelada `CircleX` + `bg-muted text-muted-foreground`. `buttonClass` = `badgeClass` + `border-transparent hover:bg-{token}/80`: é a cor do botão "Mover para {status}" (o de cancelar usa `variant="destructive"`). Classes sempre inteiras no texto, para o Tailwind enxergá-las.
- **Usa:** tokens `info`, `warning`, `success`, `muted`; ícones do lucide.
- **Histórico:** {HOJE} — criado na Fase 4 (Tarefa 10).

### RequestStatusBadge
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
- **Local:** `src/components/solicitacoes/RequestStatusBadge.tsx` (server-safe)
- **Propósito:** selo do status da solicitação (cartão, linha, tabela, detalhe, passagem).
- **Como funciona:** `<Badge variant="secondary" className="h-6 …">` com o ícone (`aria-hidden`) e o rótulo (`Solicitada`, `Em separação / Trânsito`, `Entregue`, `Cancelada`) do `REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE`. Nunca só cor.
- **Usa:** `Badge`, `statusStyle`, `REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL`.
- **Histórico:** {HOJE} — criado na Fase 4 (Tarefa 10).

### StaleBadge
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
- **Local:** `src/components/solicitacoes/StaleBadge.tsx` (server-safe)
- **Propósito:** selo "Parada há N dias" das solicitações abertas há mais de 72 h no mesmo status.
- **Como funciona:** `<Badge variant="secondary" className="h-6 bg-warning text-warning-foreground">` com `ClockAlert` (`aria-hidden`) e `staleLabel(days)` (`Parada há 1 dia`, `Parada há 5 dias`). Quem decide se a solicitação está parada é o SQL (`stale`); o selo só mostra.
- **Usa:** `Badge`, `staleLabel`, token `warning`.
- **Histórico:** {HOJE} — criado na Fase 4 (Tarefa 10).

### RequestForm
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
```

```ts
import type { AdminErrorCode } from "@/features/admin/result";

// Falhas em que a tela mostra um estado velho (alguém mexeu na solicitação
// antes): o runner não revalida em falha, então o cliente atualiza sozinho com
// router.refresh() depois de avisar (F4-20).
const STALE_SCREEN_CODES: ReadonlySet<AdminErrorCode> = new Set([
  "STATUS_CONFLICT",
  "NO_CHANGES",
  "NOT_FOUND",
]);

export function isStaleScreenCode(code: AdminErrorCode): boolean {
  return STALE_SCREEN_CODES.has(code);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 16: Write minimal implementation: `LoadMoreButton.tsx`**

Crie `src/components/solicitacoes/LoadMoreButton.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

// "Carregar mais" cresce o limite da coluna pela URL (?mais_<status>=N) sem
// rolar a página; `shown de total` vem do servidor.
export function LoadMoreButton({
  href,
  shown,
  total,
}: {
  href: string;
  shown: number;
  total: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="outline"
        disabled={pending}
        onClick={() =>
          startTransition(() => {
            router.replace(href, { scroll: false });
          })
        }
      >
        {pending ? "Carregando…" : "Carregar mais"}
      </Button>
      <p
        aria-live="polite"
        className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
      >
        {shown} de {total}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { moveLabel } from "@/features/requests/status";
import type { BoardStatus } from "@/features/requests/types";

export function MoveStatusButton({
  to,
  onClick,
  disabled = false,
  size = "default",
  className,
}: {
  to: BoardStatus;
  onClick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: "sm" | "default";
  className?: string;
}) {

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      size={size}
      className={cn(buttonClass, className)}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={onClick}
    >
      <Icon aria-hidden="true" />
      {moveLabel(to)}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { MessageSquare, SquareArrowOutUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { formatDateBR, saoPauloParts } from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";
import { nextStep } from "@/features/requests/status";
import {
  commentCountLabel,
  itemCountLabel,
  requestPreview,
} from "@/features/requests/text";
import type { BoardStatus, RequestCardView } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { requestHref } from "@/features/requests/urls";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { MoveStatusButton } from "./MoveStatusButton";
import { StaleBadge } from "./StaleBadge";

// A descrição abre o detalhe rápido (Link: a navegação no cliente é
// interceptada pelo slot @detalhe); o ↗ é um <a> comum, que abre a página
// completa (uma navegação no cliente para a mesma URL seria interceptada de novo).
export function RequestHeadline({ request }: { request: RequestCardView }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
      <Link
        href={requestHref(request.id)}
        scroll={false}
        className="line-clamp-2 min-w-0 flex-1 break-words font-medium outline-none after:absolute after:inset-0 focus-visible:underline"
      >
        {request.description}
      </Link>
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger
          render={(triggerProps) => (
            <a
              {...triggerProps}
              href={requestHref(request.id)}
              aria-label={`Abrir página completa de ${requestPreview(request.description)}`}
              className={cn(
                buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "icon-sm" }),
                "relative z-10 shrink-0",
              )}
            >
              <SquareArrowOutUpRight aria-hidden="true" />
            </a>
          )}
        />
        <TooltipContent>Abrir página completa</TooltipContent>
      </Tooltip>
    </div>
  );
}

export function RequestMeta({
  request,
  showSector,
}: {
  request: RequestCardView;
  showSector: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
      <span>Para {request.destinationName}</span>
      {showSector && <span>{request.sectorName}</span>}
      {request.itemCount > 0 && (
        <span>{itemCountLabel(request.itemCount)}</span>
      )}
      {request.commentCount > 0 && (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 tabular-nums">
          <MessageSquare className="size-3" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span aria-hidden="true">{request.commentCount}</span>
          <span className="sr-only">
            {commentCountLabel(request.commentCount)}
          </span>
        </span>
      )}
      <span>
        Criada por {request.createdByName} em{" "}
        {formatDateBR(saoPauloParts(request.createdAt).date)}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

// Cartão do Quadro. O link estica pelo cartão (after:absolute); os botões ficam
// acima dele (relative z-10).
export function RequestCard({
  request,
  showSector,
  onMove,
}: {
  request: RequestCardView;
  showSector: boolean;
  onMove?: (to: BoardStatus) => void;
}) {
  const next = nextStep(request.status);
  return (
    <article
      className={cn(
        "relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground",
        request.pending && "opacity-70",
      )}
    >
      <RequestHeadline request={request} />
      <RequestMeta request={request} showSector={showSector} />
      {request.stale && <StaleBadge days={request.daysInStatus} />}
      {onMove && next !== null && (
        <MoveStatusButton
          to={next}
          disabled={request.pending}
          className="relative z-10 w-fit"
          onClick={() => onMove(next)}
        />
      )}
    </article>
  );
}
```
