import { useId } from "react";

import { REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL } from "@/features/requests/status";
import type {
  BoardStatus,
  RequestGroupView,
  RequestListItem,
} from "@/features/requests/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { LoadMoreButton } from "./LoadMoreButton";
import { RequestCard } from "./RequestCard";
import { REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE } from "./statusStyle";

// Coluna do Quadro: contagem do servidor (total), cartões, "Carregar mais".
// O id do título vem de useId: sem `visao` o Quadro e a Lista estão os dois
// no DOM e um id derivado do status se repetiria.
export function RequestColumn({
  group,
  moreHref,
  showSector,
  note,
  onMove,
  className,
}: {
  group: RequestGroupView;
  moreHref: string | null;
  showSector: boolean;
  note: string | null;
  onMove: (request: RequestListItem, to: BoardStatus) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const { icon: Icon, badgeClass } = REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE[group.status];
  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby={headingId}
      className={cn(
        "flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h2
          id={headingId}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-medium"
        >
          <span
            className={cn(
              "flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full",
              badgeClass,
            )}
          >
            <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
          {REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[group.status]}
        </h2>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {group.total}
          <span className="sr-only"> solicitações</span>
        </span>
      </header>
      {note && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{note}</p>}
      {group.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nenhuma solicitação.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {group.rows.map((row) => (
            <li key={row.id}>
              <RequestCard
                request={row}
                showSector={showSector}
                onMove={(to) => onMove(row, to)}
              />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {moreHref && (
        <LoadMoreButton
          href={moreHref}
          shown={group.rows.length}
          total={group.total}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

  useRouter: () => ({ refresh: mocks.refresh }),

}));

function deferred<T>() {
  let resolve!: (value: T) => void;
  const promise = new Promise<T>((done) => {

  });
  return { promise, resolve };
}

function Harness({ groups }: { groups: RequestGroups }) {

                >

                </button>

  );

- [ ] **Step 32: Write minimal implementation: `useRequestMove.ts`**

Crie `src/components/solicitacoes/useRequestMove.ts`:

```ts
"use client";

import { unstable_rethrow, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useOptimistic, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { moveRequestAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import {
  type AdminResult,
  fail,
  INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE,
} from "@/features/admin/result";
import { applyMove, toGroupView } from "@/features/requests/boardMove";
import {
  movedToastMessage,
  moveFailedToastMessage,
} from "@/features/requests/messages";
import { isStaleScreenCode } from "@/features/requests/staleScreen";
import { requestPreview } from "@/features/requests/text";
import type {
  BoardStatus,
  RequestGroup,
  RequestGroupView,
  RequestListItem,
  RequestStatus,
} from "@/features/requests/types";

// Mover pelo Quadro e pela Lista: o cartão muda de coluna antes da resposta
// (useOptimistic) e volta sozinho quando a transição termina sem sucesso.
// O setOptimistic roda DENTRO da transição, antes do primeiro await.
export function useRequestMove<K extends RequestStatus>(
  groups: Readonly<Record<K, RequestGroup>>,
): {
  groups: Record<K, RequestGroupView>;
  move: (request: RequestListItem, to: BoardStatus) => void;
} {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [optimistic, setOptimistic] = useOptimistic(
    toGroupView(groups),
    (
      current: Record<K, RequestGroupView>,
      intent: Parameters<typeof applyMove>[1],
    ) => applyMove(current, intent),
  );

  function move(request: RequestListItem, to: BoardStatus) {
    const preview = requestPreview(request.description);
    startTransition(async () => {
      setOptimistic({ id: request.id, to, at: new Date() });
      let result: AdminResult<{ status: RequestStatus }>;
      try {
        result = await moveRequestAction({
          id: request.id,
          from: request.status,
          to,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // redirect() e notFound() são exceções do Next: têm de seguir adiante.
        unstable_rethrow(error);
        result = fail("INTERNAL", INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE);
      }
      if (result.ok) {
        toast.success(movedToastMessage(preview, to));
        return;
      }
      toast.error(moveFailedToastMessage(preview, result.message));
      if (isStaleScreenCode(result.code)) router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return { groups: optimistic, move };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { CLOSED_WINDOW_DAYS } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import {
  BOARD_STATUSES,
  REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL,
} from "@/features/requests/status";
import type { BoardStatus, RequestGroup } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { RequestColumn } from "./RequestColumn";
import { useRequestMove } from "./useRequestMove";

// Quadro: três colunas lado a lado a partir de `lg`, empilhadas entre `md` e
// `lg`; abaixo de `md` uma coluna por vez, escolhida pelos botões. O seletor é
// SÓ CSS (as três colunas ficam montadas): o servidor não sabe a largura da
// tela, então nada aqui usa matchMedia (a hidratação divergiria).
export function RequestBoard({
  groups,
  moreHrefs,
  showSector,
  closedWindow,
}: {
  groups: Readonly<Record<BoardStatus, RequestGroup>>;
  moreHrefs: Readonly<Record<BoardStatus, string | null>>;
  showSector: boolean;
  closedWindow: boolean;
}) {
  const view = useRequestMove(groups);
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<BoardStatus>("requested");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <FieldSet className="md:hidden">
        <FieldLegend className="sr-only">Coluna</FieldLegend>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {BOARD_STATUSES.map((status) => (
            <Button
              key={status}
              type="button"
              variant={status === chosen ? "default" : "outline"}
              aria-pressed={status === chosen}
              onClick={() => setChosen(status)}
            >
              {`${REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[status]} (${view.groups[status].total})`}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </FieldSet>
      <div className="grid items-start gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {BOARD_STATUSES.map((status) => (
          <RequestColumn
            key={status}
            group={view.groups[status]}
            moreHref={moreHrefs[status]}
            showSector={showSector}
            note={
              status === "delivered" && closedWindow
                ? `Últimos ${CLOSED_WINDOW_DAYS} dias`
                : null
            }
            onMove={view.move}
            className={cn(status !== chosen && "max-md:hidden")}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

import { nextStep } from "@/features/requests/status";
import type { BoardStatus, RequestCardView } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { MoveStatusButton } from "./MoveStatusButton";
import { RequestHeadline, RequestMeta } from "./RequestCard";
import { StaleBadge } from "./StaleBadge";

// Linha da Lista (padrão no celular): o mesmo conteúdo do cartão, em linha, e
// o mesmo próximo passo (a Lista é onde se avança no celular).
export function RequestListRow({
  request,
  showSector,
  onMove,
}: {
  request: RequestCardView;
  showSector: boolean;
  onMove?: (to: BoardStatus) => void;
}) {
  const next = nextStep(request.status);
  return (
    <li
      className={cn(
        "relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between",
        request.pending && "opacity-70",
      )}
    >
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
        <RequestHeadline request={request} />
        <RequestMeta request={request} showSector={showSector} />
        {request.stale && <StaleBadge days={request.daysInStatus} />}
      </div>
      {onMove && next !== null && (
        <MoveStatusButton
          to={next}
          disabled={request.pending}
          className="relative z-10 w-fit shrink-0"
          onClick={() => onMove(next)}
        />
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

  moreHref,
  showSector,
  note,
  onMove,
}: {
  group: RequestGroupView;
  moreHref: string | null;
  showSector: boolean;
  note: string | null;
  onMove: (request: RequestListItem, to: BoardStatus) => void;
}) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const { icon: Icon, badgeClass } = REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE[group.status];
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h2
          id={headingId}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-medium"
        >
          <span
            className={cn(
              "flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full",
              badgeClass,
            )}
          >
            <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
          {REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[group.status]}
        </h2>
        <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {group.total}
          <span className="sr-only"> solicitações</span>
        </span>
      </header>
      {note && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{note}</p>}
      {group.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nenhuma solicitação.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {group.rows.map((row) => (
            <RequestListRow
              key={row.id}
              request={row}
              showSector={showSector}
              onMove={(to) => onMove(row, to)}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {moreHref && (
        <LoadMoreButton
          href={moreHref}
          shown={group.rows.length}
          total={group.total}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// Lista agrupada por status (os quatro, incluindo Cancelada): padrão no celular.
export function RequestList({
  groups,
  moreHrefs,
  showSector,
  closedWindow,
}: {
  groups: RequestGroups;
  moreHrefs: Readonly<Record<RequestStatus, string | null>>;
  showSector: boolean;
  closedWindow: boolean;
}) {
  const view = useRequestMove(groups);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {REQUEST_STATUS_ORDER.map((status: RequestStatus) => (
        <ListGroup
          key={status}
          group={view.groups[status]}
          moreHref={moreHrefs[status]}
          showSector={showSector}
          note={
            closedWindow && !isOpenStatus(status)
              ? `Últimos ${CLOSED_WINDOW_DAYS} dias`
              : null
          }
          onMove={view.move}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

                  scroll={false}

                  {row.description}

              {showSector && <TableCell>{row.sectorName}</TableCell>}

                {destinationLabel(row.destinationName, row.destinationIsOther)}

              <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                {row.itemCount}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>{row.createdByName}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                {formatDateBR(saoPauloParts(row.createdAt).date)}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                  <RequestStatusBadge status={row.status} />
                  {row.stale && <StaleBadge days={row.daysInStatus} />}
                </div>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">
                {row.daysInStatus}
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
      <Pagination
        page={page.page}
        pageCount={page.pageCount}
        pathname={REQUESTS_PATH}
        params={pageParams}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

```tsx
import { List, SquareKanban, Table2 } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { RequestView } from "@/features/requests/requestFilters";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const VIEWS = [
  { view: "board", label: "Quadro", icon: SquareKanban },
  { view: "list", label: "Lista", icon: List },
  { view: "table", label: "Tabela", icon: Table2 },
] as const;

// Seletor de visão: três links (navegação com cara de botão). Sem `visao` na
// URL a tela renderiza este seletor duas vezes (um por largura, só CSS) para o
// aria-current dizer a verdade em cada uma.
export function RequestViewSwitcher({
  current,
  hrefs,
  className,
}: {
  current: RequestView;
  hrefs: Readonly<Record<RequestView, string>>;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Visão" className={cn("flex flex-wrap gap-2", className)}>
      {VIEWS.map(({ view, label, icon: Icon }) => (
        <Link
          key={view}
          href={hrefs[view]}
          aria-current={view === current ? "page" : undefined}
          className={buttonVariants({
            variant: view === current ? "default" : "outline",
          })}
        >
          <Icon aria-hidden="true" />
          {label}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}
```

Crie `src/components/solicitacoes/RequestFiltersForm.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { type FormEvent, useId, useState } from "react";

import { SelectField } from "@/components/admin/SelectField";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  DESTINATION_OTHER,
  SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH,
} from "@/features/requests/limits";
import {
  buildRequestsHref,
  clearFiltersHref,
  type RequestFilters,
  type RequestPeriod,
  resetPaging,
} from "@/features/requests/requestFilters";
import { normalizeSearch } from "@/features/requests/search";
import type {
  FilterDestination,
  PersonChoice,
} from "@/features/requests/types";

const ALL = "all";

const PERIOD_OPTIONS: readonly { value: RequestPeriod; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "all", label: "Todo o período" },
  { value: "7", label: "Últimos 7 dias" },
  { value: "30", label: "Últimos 30 dias" },
  { value: "range", label: "Intervalo" },
];

function isPeriod(value: string): value is RequestPeriod {
  return PERIOD_OPTIONS.some((option) => option.value === value);
}

// Filtros das solicitações, controlados. Os valores iniciais vêm da URL já
// interpretada no servidor, então nunca começam em branco. "Aplicar filtros"
// monta a URL (volta à primeira página, mantém visão e setor); "Limpar
// filtros" é um link.
export function RequestFiltersForm({
  filters,
  destinations,
  creators,
  sectorParam,
}: {
  filters: RequestFilters;
  destinations: readonly FilterDestination[];
  creators: readonly PersonChoice[];
  sectorParam: string | null;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const uid = useId();
  const [destination, setDestination] = useState(filters.destination ?? ALL);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<RequestPeriod>(filters.period);
  const [from, setFrom] = useState(filters.from ?? "");
  const [to, setTo] = useState(filters.to ?? "");
  const [creatorId, setCreatorId] = useState(filters.creatorId ?? ALL);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState(filters.search);
  const extras = sectorParam === null ? {} : { sector: sectorParam };

  function apply(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    router.push(
      buildRequestsHref(
        resetPaging({
          ...filters,
          destination: destination === ALL ? null : destination,
          period,
          from: period === "range" ? from : null,
          to: period === "range" ? to : null,
          creatorId: creatorId === ALL ? null : creatorId,
          search: normalizeSearch(search),
        }),
        extras,
      ),
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={apply}
      aria-label="Filtros das solicitações"
      className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground"
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${uid}-search`}>Busca</FieldLabel>
          <Input
            id={`${uid}-search`}
            type="search"
            className="text-base md:text-base"
            placeholder="Descrição ou destino"
            maxLength={SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH}
            autoComplete="off"
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
          />
        </Field>
        <SelectField
          label="Destino"
          value={destination}
          onValueChange={setDestination}
          options={[
            { value: ALL, label: "Todos os destinos" },
            ...destinations.map((entry) => ({
              value: entry.id,
              label: entry.active ? entry.name : `${entry.name} (inativo)`,
            })),
            { value: DESTINATION_OTHER, label: "Outro" },
          ]}
        />
        <SelectField
          label="Período"
          value={period}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            if (isPeriod(value)) setPeriod(value);
          }}
          options={PERIOD_OPTIONS}
        />
        <SelectField
          label="Quem criou"
          value={creatorId}
          onValueChange={setCreatorId}
          options={[
            { value: ALL, label: "Todas as pessoas" },
            ...creators.map((person) => ({
              value: person.id,
              label: person.name,
            })),
          ]}
        />
        {period === "range" && (
          <>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${uid}-from`}>De</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${uid}-from`}
                type="date"
                className="text-base md:text-base"
                value={from}
                onChange={(event) => setFrom(event.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${uid}-to`}>Até</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id={`${uid}-to`}
                type="date"
                className="text-base md:text-base"
                value={to}
                onChange={(event) => setTo(event.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button type="submit">Aplicar filtros</Button>
        <Link
          href={clearFiltersHref(filters.view, extras)}
          className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost" })}
        >
          Limpar filtros
        </Link>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

    expect(within(requested).getAllByRole("article")).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(within(requested).getByText("20 de 25")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      within(requested).getByRole("button", { name: "Carregar mais" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("Nova solicitação: operador não escolhe setor; admin em Todos escolhe", async () => {
    const { sector, ana } = await seed();
    operator(sector.id, ana.id);
    await renderScreen({ visao: "quadro" });
    await userEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Nova solicitação" }),
    );
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Nova solicitação",
    });
    expect(within(dialog).queryByLabelText("Setor")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Destino")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("Nova solicitação do admin em Todos os setores tem o campo Setor", async () => {
    await seed();
    admin();
    await renderScreen({ visao: "quadro", setor: "todos" });

    await userEvent.click(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Nova solicitação" }),
    );

    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", {
      name: "Nova solicitação",
    });
    expect(within(dialog).getByLabelText("Setor")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Crie `src/components/solicitacoes/RequestsScreen.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/admin/EmptyState";
import { SectorPicker } from "@/components/passagens/SectorPicker";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { listActiveSectors, type SectorChoice } from "@/features/admin/sectors";
import { isAdmin } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { ALL_SECTORS } from "@/features/handovers/limits";
import { loadSector } from "@/features/handovers/loaders";
import { addDays, todayInSaoPaulo } from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";
import { resolveHandoverSector } from "@/features/handovers/sectorChoice";
import { readRememberedSector } from "@/features/handovers/sectorCookie";
import {
  getRequestFormChoices,
  listFilterDestinations,
  listRequestCreators,
} from "@/features/requests/choices";
import { BOARD_MAX_LIMIT, DESTINATION_OTHER } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { getRequestGroups, listRequestTable } from "@/features/requests/lists";
import {
  buildRequestsHref,
  clearFiltersHref,
  filtersActive,
  moreHref,
  parseRequestFilters,
  type RequestFilters,
  viewHrefs,
} from "@/features/requests/requestFilters";
import { boardSummary, tableSummary } from "@/features/requests/text";
import type { RequestGroups, RequestStatus } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { REQUEST_STATUSES } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { NewRequestDialog } from "./NewRequestDialog";
import { RequestBoard } from "./RequestBoard";
import { RequestFiltersForm } from "./RequestFiltersForm";
import { RequestList } from "./RequestList";
import { RequestTable } from "./RequestTable";
import { RequestViewSwitcher } from "./RequestViewSwitcher";

type RequestsScreenProps = {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
};

const TITLE = "Solicitações";

function Header({
  subtitle,
  action,
}: {
  subtitle?: string;
  action?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{TITLE}</h1>
        {subtitle && <p className="text-muted-foreground">{subtitle}</p>}
      </div>
      {action}
    </header>
  );
}

// Os filtros que a Pagination preserva: a mesma URL que buildRequestsHref monta.
function paginationParams(href: string): Record<string, string> {
  return Object.fromEntries(new URL(href, "http://closery.local").searchParams);
}

function moreHrefs(
  groups: RequestGroups,
  filters: RequestFilters,
  extras: { sector?: string },
): Record<RequestStatus, string | null> {
  const result: Record<RequestStatus, string | null> = {
    requested: null,
    in_transit: null,
    delivered: null,
    cancelled: null,
  };
  for (const status of REQUEST_STATUSES) {
    const group = groups[status];
    result[status] =
      group.rows.length < group.total && group.limit < BOARD_MAX_LIMIT
        ? moreHref(filters, status, extras)
        : null;
  }
  return result;
}

export async function RequestsScreen({ searchParams }: RequestsScreenProps) {
  const actor = await requireUser();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const now = new Date();
  const today = todayInSaoPaulo(now);
  const parsed = parseRequestFilters(params, today);
  const admin = isAdmin(actor);

  // Admin escolhe o setor (ou "Todos os setores", sem cookie); operador usa o
  // próprio setor e nunca vê o seletor.
  let sectorId: string | null = null;
  let sectorParam: string | null = null;
  let picker: ReactNode = null;
  let sectors: SectorChoice[] = [];
  let cookie: string | undefined;

  if (admin) {
    sectors = await listActiveSectors(db);
    cookie = await readRememberedSector();
    const selection = resolveHandoverSector(
      sectors,
      { url: params.setor, cookie },
      { allowAll: true },
    );
    if (selection.kind === "none") {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <Header />
          <EmptyState
            title="Nenhum setor ativo."
            description="Cadastre ou reative um setor para usar as solicitações."
            action={{ label: "Ir para Setores", href: "/admin/setores" }}
          />
        </div>
      );
    }
    sectorId = selection.kind === "sector" ? selection.sector.id : null;
    sectorParam =
      selection.kind === "sector" ? selection.sector.id : ALL_SECTORS;
    picker = (
      <SectorPicker
        sectors={sectors}
        selectedId={sectorParam}
        path="/solicitacoes"
        allowAll
      />
    );
  } else {
    const own = actor.sectorId
      ? await loadSector(db, actor, actor.sectorId)
      : null;
    if (!own?.active) {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <Header />
          <EmptyState
            title="Seu setor está inativo."
            description="Peça a um administrador para reativá-lo."
          />
        </div>
      );
    }
    sectorId = own.id;
  }

  const [creators, destinations] = await Promise.all([
    listRequestCreators(db, actor, sectorId),
    listFilterDestinations(db),
  ]);

  // Quem criou e destino que o seletor não sabe mostrar viram "todos" antes da
  // consulta ("outro" é uma opção fixa, sempre vale).
  const filters: RequestFilters = {
    ...parsed,
    creatorId: creators.some((person) => person.id === parsed.creatorId)
      ? parsed.creatorId
      : null,
    destination:
      parsed.destination === DESTINATION_OTHER ||
      destinations.some((entry) => entry.id === parsed.destination)
        ? parsed.destination
        : null,
  };
  const extras = sectorParam === null ? {} : { sector: sectorParam };
  const showSector = admin && sectorId === null;

  const formSectors = showSector ? sectors : null;
  const initialSectorId =
    sectorId ??
    (() => {
      const first = resolveHandoverSector(sectors, { url: undefined, cookie });
      return first.kind === "sector" ? first.sector.id : "";
    })();
  const choices = await getRequestFormChoices(
    db,
    showSector ? sectors.map((entry) => entry.id) : [initialSectorId],
  );

  const input = { sectorId, filters };
  const table =
    filters.view === "table"
      ? await listRequestTable(db, actor, input, now)
      : null;
  const groups =
    table === null ? await getRequestGroups(db, actor, input, now) : null;

  const closedWindow = filters.period === "all";
  const subtitle =
    table !== null
      ? tableSummary(table.total)
      : groups !== null
        ? boardSummary(
            {
              requested: groups.requested.total,
              in_transit: groups.in_transit.total,
              delivered: groups.delivered.total,
            },
            closedWindow,
          )
        : undefined;
  const empty =
    table !== null
      ? table.total === 0
      : groups !== null &&
        REQUEST_STATUSES.every((status) => groups[status].total === 0);

  // Os filtros do formulário nunca começam em branco: o intervalo abre com a
  // última semana quando o período ainda é "Todo o período".
  const formFilters: RequestFilters = {
    ...filters,
    from: filters.from ?? addDays(today, -6),
    to: filters.to ?? today,
  };
  const hrefs = viewHrefs(filters, extras);

  let body: ReactNode;
  if (empty) {
    body = filtersActive(filters) ? (
      <EmptyState
        title="Nenhuma solicitação com esses filtros."
        description="Mude ou limpe os filtros para ver mais."
        action={{
          label: "Limpar filtros",
          href: clearFiltersHref(filters.view, extras),
        }}
      />
    ) : (
      <EmptyState
        title="Nenhuma solicitação para mostrar."
        description={
          table !== null
            ? "Use “Nova solicitação” para criar uma."
            : "Aparecem aqui as abertas e as entregues ou canceladas nos últimos 30 dias. Use “Nova solicitação” para criar uma."
        }
      />
    );
  } else if (table !== null) {
    body = (
      <RequestTable
        page={table}
        showSector={showSector}
        pageParams={paginationParams(buildRequestsHref(filters, extras))}
      />
    );
  } else if (groups !== null) {
    const more = moreHrefs(groups, filters, extras);
    const board = (
      <RequestBoard
        groups={groups}
        moreHrefs={more}
        showSector={showSector}
        closedWindow={closedWindow}
      />
    );
    const list = (
      <RequestList
        groups={groups}
        moreHrefs={more}
        showSector={showSector}
        closedWindow={closedWindow}
      />
    );
    // Sem `visao` o servidor não sabe a largura: as duas visões vão no DOM e o
    // CSS mostra a Lista abaixo de md e o Quadro de md em diante.
    body =
      filters.view === "board" ? (
        board
      ) : filters.view === "list" ? (
        list
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="hidden md:block">{board}</div>
          <div className="md:hidden">{list}</div>
        </>
      );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Header
        subtitle={subtitle}
        action={
          <NewRequestDialog
            sectors={formSectors}
            initialSectorId={initialSectorId}
            choices={choices}
            originRef={null}
          />
        }
      />
      {picker}
      <RequestFiltersForm
        key={buildRequestsHref(filters, extras)}
        filters={formFilters}
        destinations={destinations}
        creators={creators}
        sectorParam={sectorParam}
      />
      {filters.view === null ? (
        <>
          <RequestViewSwitcher
            current="list"
            hrefs={hrefs}
            className="md:hidden"
          />
          <RequestViewSwitcher
            current="board"
            hrefs={hrefs}
            className="hidden md:flex"
          />
        </>
      ) : (
        <RequestViewSwitcher current={filters.view} hrefs={hrefs} />
      )}
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}
```

import type { Metadata } from "next";

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent } from "@/components/ui/sheet";

// Detalhe rápido da solicitação: o Sheet da rota interceptada. `open` é
// constante (o slot só existe enquanto a URL é a do detalhe): estado local não
// reabriria sob a Activity. Fechar = voltar no histórico, uma vez só: a trava
// impede dois router.back() (Escape + Fechar, ou fundo + Escape) antes de a
// navegação terminar, que tirariam a pessoa da tela de baixo.
export function RequestSheet({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const closing = useRef(false);

  // Roda de novo quando a Activity revela o slot outra vez.
  useEffect(() => {
    closing.current = false;
  }, []);

  function handleOpenChange(open: boolean) {
    if (open || closing.current) return;
    closing.current = true;
    router.back();
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <SheetContent
        side="right"
        showCloseButton={false}
        className="w-full overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:max-w-xl"
      >
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <SheetClose
            render={
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="max-md:h-11"
              />
            }
          >
            Fechar
          </SheetClose>
        </div>
        {children}
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

import { timelineSentence } from "@/features/requests/timeline";
import type { RequestTimelineEntry } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { formatDateTimeBR } from "@/lib/dateTime";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE } from "./statusStyle";

// Linha do tempo: mais antigo primeiro. O ícone é o do status de destino; o
// motivo do cancelamento aparece junto do "cancelou".
export function RequestTimeline({
  entries,
}: {
  entries: readonly RequestTimelineEntry[];
}) {
  return (
    <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {entries.map((entry) => {
        const { icon: Icon, badgeClass } = REQUEST_STATUS_STYLE[entry.to];
        return (
          <li key={entry.id} className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <span
              className={cn(
                "mt-0.5 flex size-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full",
                badgeClass,
              )}
            >
              <Icon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden="true" />
            </span>
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">{timelineSentence(entry)}</p>
              <time
                dateTime={entry.at.toISOString()}
                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
              >
                {formatDateTimeBR(entry.at)}
              </time>
              {entry.reason !== null && (
                <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap text-muted-foreground">
                  Motivo: {entry.reason}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

"use client";

import { toast } from "sonner";

import { deleteCommentAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/admin/ConfirmDialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatDateTimeBR } from "@/lib/dateTime";

// Apagar o próprio comentário, com confirmação; o motivo de cancelamento não
// chega aqui (o servidor também recusa).
export function DeleteCommentButton({
  commentId,
  createdAt,
}: {
  commentId: string;
  createdAt: Date;
}) {
  return (
    <ConfirmDialog
      trigger={
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          aria-label={`Apagar comentário de ${formatDateTimeBR(createdAt)}`}
        >
          Apagar
        </Button>
      }
      title="Apagar comentário?"
      description="Ele some da solicitação para todos."
      confirmLabel="Apagar comentário"
      destructive
      onConfirm={async () => {
        const result = await deleteCommentAction({ id: commentId });
        if (result.ok) toast.success("Comentário apagado.");
        return result;
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { type FormEvent, useId, useState } from "react";

import { addCommentAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import { useAdminAction } from "@/components/admin/useAdminAction";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { COMMENT_MAX_LENGTH } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { addCommentSchema } from "@/features/requests/schemas";

// Compositor de comentário: limpa só no sucesso; o erro fica no campo e o
// texto digitado nunca se perde.
export function CommentComposer({ requestId }: { requestId: string }) {
  const fieldId = useId();
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { pending, run } = useAdminAction();

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const parsed = addCommentSchema.safeParse({ requestId, body });
    if (!parsed.success) {
      setError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? null);
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    const result = await run(() => addCommentAction({ requestId, body }), {
      showError: false,
      success: "Comentário adicionado.",
    });
    if (result.ok) {
      setBody("");
    } else {
      setError(result.fieldErrors?.body ?? result.message);
    }
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-col gap-2" noValidate>
      <Field data-invalid={error ? "true" : undefined}>
        <FieldLabel htmlFor={fieldId}>Novo comentário</FieldLabel>
        <Textarea
          id={fieldId}
          className="text-base md:text-base"
          rows={3}
          maxLength={COMMENT_MAX_LENGTH}
          value={body}
          disabled={pending}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          onChange={(event) => setBody(event.target.value)}
        />
        {error && <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>}
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" className="w-fit" disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? "Comentando…" : "Comentar"}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { RequestCommentsPage } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { formatDateTimeBR } from "@/lib/dateTime";

import { CommentComposer } from "./CommentComposer";
import { DeleteCommentButton } from "./DeleteCommentButton";

// Comentários (mais antigo primeiro, os últimos N). O motivo de cancelamento
// aparece aqui também, com o rótulo e sem "Apagar". `earlierHref` é um <a>
// comum: a página completa mostra os anteriores.
export function RequestComments({
  requestId,
  comments,
  canComment,
  earlierHref,
  headingLevel = 2,
}: {
  requestId: string;
  comments: RequestCommentsPage;
  canComment: boolean;
  earlierHref: string | null;
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3;
}) {
  const Heading = headingLevel === 2 ? "h2" : "h3";
  return (
    <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Heading className="text-base font-medium tabular-nums">
        {comments.total > 0 ? `Comentários (${comments.total})` : "Comentários"}
      </Heading>
      {earlierHref && (
        <a
          href={earlierHref}
          className="w-fit text-sm underline underline-offset-4"
        >
          Ver comentários anteriores
        </a>
      )}
      {comments.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Nenhum comentário ainda.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          {comments.rows.map((comment) => (
            <li
              key={comment.id}
              className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-lg border p-3"
            >
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <p className="text-sm">
                  <span className="font-medium">{comment.authorName}</span>
                  {" · "}
                  <time
                    dateTime={comment.createdAt.toISOString()}
                    className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
                  >
                    {formatDateTimeBR(comment.createdAt)}
                  </time>
                </p>
                {comment.canDelete && (
                  <DeleteCommentButton
                    commentId={comment.id}
                    createdAt={comment.createdAt}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              {comment.isCancelReason && (
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  Motivo do cancelamento
                </p>
              )}
              <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{comment.body}</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      {canComment && <CommentComposer requestId={requestId} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { type FormEvent, useId, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { cancelRequestAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import { useAdminAction } from "@/components/admin/useAdminAction";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { CANCEL_REASON_MAX_LENGTH } from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { cancelRequestSchema } from "@/features/requests/schemas";
import { isStaleScreenCode } from "@/features/requests/staleScreen";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

// Cancelar exige motivo (≤ 500). Só fecha sozinho no sucesso; qualquer outra
// falha fica no diálogo, com o texto digitado.
export function CancelRequestDialog({
  requestId,
  from,
}: {
  requestId: string;
  from: RequestStatus;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [reasonError, setReasonError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [footerError, setFooterError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { pending, run } = useAdminAction();

  function handleOpenChange(next: boolean) {
    if (pending) return;
    if (next) {
      setReason("");
      setReasonError(null);
      setFooterError(null);
    }
    setOpen(next);
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const parsed = cancelRequestSchema.safeParse({
      id: requestId,
      from,
      reason,
    });
    if (!parsed.success) {
      setReasonError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? null);
      return;
    }
    setReasonError(null);
    setFooterError(null);
    const result = await run(
      () => cancelRequestAction({ id: requestId, from, reason }),
      { showError: false, success: "Solicitação cancelada." },
    );
    if (result.ok) {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    if (isStaleScreenCode(result.code)) {
      toast.error(result.message);
      setOpen(false);
      router.refresh();
      return;
    }
    if (result.fieldErrors?.reason) {
      setReasonError(result.fieldErrors.reason);
      return;
    }
    setFooterError(result.message);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button type="button" variant="destructive" />}>
        Cancelar solicitação
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent showCloseButton={false}>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Cancelar solicitação</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            O motivo fica na linha do tempo e nos comentários.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form
          id={`${fieldId}-form`}
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          className="flex flex-col gap-4"
          noValidate
        >
          <Field data-invalid={reasonError ? "true" : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={fieldId}>Motivo do cancelamento</FieldLabel>
            <Textarea
              id={fieldId}
              className="text-base md:text-base"
              rows={3}
              maxLength={CANCEL_REASON_MAX_LENGTH}
              value={reason}
              disabled={pending}
              aria-invalid={reasonError ? true : undefined}
              onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)}
            />
            <FieldDescription>Obrigatório.</FieldDescription>
            {reasonError && <FieldError>{reasonError}</FieldError>}
          </Field>
          <FieldError>{footerError}</FieldError>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={pending}
              onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Voltar
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" variant="destructive" disabled={pending}>
              {pending ? "Cancelando…" : "Cancelar solicitação"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { moveRequestAction } from "@/app/(app)/solicitacoes/actions";
import { useAdminAction } from "@/components/admin/useAdminAction";
import {
  movedToastMessage,
  moveFailedToastMessage,
} from "@/features/requests/messages";
import { isStaleScreenCode } from "@/features/requests/staleScreen";
import { moveTargets } from "@/features/requests/status";
import { requestPreview } from "@/features/requests/text";
import type { BoardStatus } from "@/features/requests/types";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { CancelRequestDialog } from "./CancelRequestDialog";
import { MoveStatusButton } from "./MoveStatusButton";

// "Mudar status" no detalhe: um botão por status alvo (na cor do destino) e,
// separado, "Cancelar solicitação" (pede o motivo).
export function RequestStatusActions({
  requestId,
  status,
  description,
  canCancel,
}: {
  requestId: string;
  status: RequestStatus;
  description: string;
  canCancel: boolean;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { pending, run } = useAdminAction();
  const preview = requestPreview(description);

  async function move(to: BoardStatus) {
    const result = await run(
      () => moveRequestAction({ id: requestId, from: status, to }),
      { showError: false, success: movedToastMessage(preview, to) },
    );
    if (result.ok) return;
    toast.error(moveFailedToastMessage(preview, result.message));
    if (isStaleScreenCode(result.code)) router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      {moveTargets(status).map((to) => (
        <MoveStatusButton
          key={to}
          to={to}
          disabled={pending}
          onClick={() => move(to)}
        />
      ))}
      {canCancel && <CancelRequestDialog requestId={requestId} from={status} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { SquareArrowOutUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { ReadOnlySectorNotice } from "@/components/passagens/ReadOnlySectorNotice";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { SheetDescription, SheetTitle } from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { idSchema } from "@/features/admin/schemas";
import { isAdmin } from "@/features/authz/authz";
import { formatQuantity } from "@/features/handovers/quantity";
import {
  formatDateBR,
  formatTimeBR,
  saoPauloParts,
} from "@/features/handovers/saoPaulo";
import { handoverHref } from "@/features/handovers/urls";
import { getRequestDetail } from "@/features/requests/detail";
import {
  COMMENTS_MAX_LIMIT,
  COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
} from "@/features/requests/limits";
import { destinationLabel } from "@/features/requests/text";
import { requestHref, requestsHref } from "@/features/requests/urls";
import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { RequestComments } from "./RequestComments";
import { RequestStatusActions } from "./RequestStatusActions";
import { RequestStatusBadge } from "./RequestStatusBadge";
import { RequestTimeline } from "./RequestTimeline";
import { StaleBadge } from "./StaleBadge";

type RequestDetailProps = {
  id: string;
  variant: "page" | "sheet";
  commentsLimit: number;
};

// "dd/mm/aaaa às HH:mm" no fuso de São Paulo.
function dateAndTime(date: Date): string {
  return `${formatDateBR(saoPauloParts(date).date)} às ${formatTimeBR(date)}`;
}

// Mesmo componente servidor na página completa e no Sheet (rota interceptada).
export async function RequestDetail({
  id,
  variant,
  commentsLimit,
}: RequestDetailProps) {
  const actor = await requireUser();
  const result = idSchema.safeParse(id).success
    ? await getRequestDetail(db, actor, { id, commentsLimit }, new Date())
    : null;

  if (result === null || !result.ok) {
    // No Sheet o estado fica dentro dele: um notFound() no slot derrubaria a tela.
    if (variant === "page") notFound();
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <SheetTitle>Solicitação não encontrada.</SheetTitle>
        <SheetDescription>Ela não existe ou é de outro setor.</SheetDescription>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { detail } = result;
  const { capabilities } = detail;
  const admin = isAdmin(actor);
  const title = `Solicitação para ${detail.destinationName}`;
  const Section = variant === "page" ? "h2" : "h3";
  const headingLevel = variant === "page" ? 2 : 3;
  const earlierHref =
    detail.comments.hasEarlier && detail.comments.limit < COMMENTS_MAX_LIMIT
      ? requestHref(detail.id, {
          comments: detail.comments.limit + COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
        })
      : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {variant === "page" ? (
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{title}</h1>
        ) : (
          <SheetTitle className="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
            {title}
          </SheetTitle>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{detail.description}</p>
        {variant === "sheet" ? (
          <a
            href={requestHref(detail.id)}
            className={cn(
              buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }),
              "w-fit",
            )}
          >
            <SquareArrowOutUpRight aria-hidden="true" />
            Abrir página completa
          </a>
        ) : (
          <Link
            href={requestsHref(admin ? detail.sectorId : null)}
            className="w-fit text-sm underline underline-offset-4"
          >
            Ver todas as solicitações
          </Link>
        )}
      </header>

      {!detail.sectorActive && <ReadOnlySectorNotice />}

      <dl className="grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] items-baseline gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-sm">
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Status</dt>
        <dd className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <RequestStatusBadge status={detail.status} />
          {detail.stale && <StaleBadge days={detail.daysInStatus} />}
        </dd>
        {admin && (
          <>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Setor</dt>
            <dd>{detail.sectorName}</dd>
          </>
        )}
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Destino</dt>
        <dd>
          {destinationLabel(detail.destinationName, detail.destinationIsOther)}
        </dd>
        <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Criada por</dt>
        <dd>
          {detail.createdByName} em {dateAndTime(detail.createdAt)}
        </dd>
        {detail.origin && (
          <>
            <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Origem</dt>
            <dd>
              <Link
                href={handoverHref(detail.origin.handoverId)}
                className="underline underline-offset-4"
              >
                Criada na passagem de {detail.origin.shiftName} de{" "}
                {formatDateBR(detail.origin.operationalDate)}
              </Link>
            </dd>
          </>
        )}
      </dl>

      <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Section className="text-base font-medium">Itens</Section>
        {detail.items.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nenhum item.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y rounded-lg border">
            {detail.items.map((line) => (
              <li
                key={line.itemId}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
              >
                <span>{line.name}</span>
                <span className="tabular-nums">
                  {formatQuantity(line.quantity)} {line.unit}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      {capabilities.canMove && (
        <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <Section className="text-base font-medium">Mudar status</Section>
          <RequestStatusActions
            requestId={detail.id}
            status={detail.status}
            description={detail.description}
            canCancel={capabilities.canCancel}
          />
        </section>
      )}

      <section className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <Section className="text-base font-medium">Linha do tempo</Section>
        <RequestTimeline entries={detail.timeline} />
      </section>

      <RequestComments
        requestId={detail.id}
        comments={detail.comments}
        canComment={capabilities.canComment}
        earlierHref={earlierHref}
        headingLevel={headingLevel}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Suspense } from "react";

import { RequestDetail } from "@/components/solicitacoes/RequestDetail";
import { RequestDetailSkeleton } from "@/components/solicitacoes/RequestDetailSkeleton";
import { parseCommentsLimit } from "@/features/requests/urls";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Solicitação" };

// params e searchParams são dinâmicos: só dentro do <Suspense> (Cache Components).
export default function RequestPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<RequestDetailSkeleton />}>
      <Content params={params} searchParams={searchParams} />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

async function Content({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const query = await searchParams;
  return (
    <RequestDetail
      id={id}
      variant="page"
      commentsLimit={parseCommentsLimit(query.comentarios)}
    />
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 44: Write minimal implementation: `layout.tsx` renderiza o slot**

Leia `src/app/(app)/layout.tsx`. A função passa a receber `detalhe` (o tipo `LayoutProps<"/">` gerado pelo `next typegen` já inclui o slot assim que a pasta `@detalhe` existe) e renderiza `{detalhe}` logo depois do `<div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-4 md:p-6">{children}</div>`, ainda dentro do `SidebarInset`. O arquivo inteiro fica assim:

```tsx
import { Suspense } from "react";

import { AuthedSidebar } from "@/components/app-shell/AuthedSidebar";
import { MenuToggle } from "@/components/app-shell/MenuToggle";
import { SessionKeepAlive } from "@/components/app-shell/SessionKeepAlive";
import { SidebarSkeleton } from "@/components/app-shell/SidebarSkeleton";
import { SidebarInset, SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";

// Sem await aqui: a sessão é lida dentro do <Suspense> (Cache Components).
// O layout não protege as páginas: cada página chama requireUser/requireAdmin
// (guardado por src/app/appPagesAuth.test.ts). O slot `detalhe` abre o detalhe
// da solicitação num Sheet por cima da tela atual (rota interceptada); fica
// fora de qualquer <Suspense> daqui: o Suspense vive na página interceptada.
export default function AppLayout({ children, detalhe }: LayoutProps<"/">) {
  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <SessionKeepAlive />
      <Suspense fallback={<SidebarSkeleton />}>
        <AuthedSidebar />
      </Suspense>
      <SidebarInset>
        <header className="flex h-12 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 border-b px-4 max-md:h-14">
          <MenuToggle />
        </header>
        <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-4 md:p-6">{children}</div>
        {detalhe}
      </SidebarInset>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
```

Componentes de domínio`):

```markdown
### RequestDetail
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
- **Local:** `src/components/solicitacoes/RequestDetail.tsx`
- **Propósito:** o detalhe da solicitação: a página completa `/solicitacoes/[id]` e o conteúdo do Sheet do detalhe rápido.
- **Como funciona:** server component async, `variant="page" | "sheet"`. `page`: título `<h1>` "Solicitação para {destino}", seções `h2`, link "Ver todas as solicitações", `notFound()` para id malformado, inexistente ou de outro setor. `sheet`: título pelo `SheetTitle`, seções `h3`, link `<a href>` "Abrir página completa" (navegação de documento: uma navegação no cliente para a mesma URL seria interceptada de novo), e o estado "Solicitação não encontrada." dentro do Sheet (um `notFound()` no slot derrubaria a tela). Mostra o aviso `ReadOnlySectorNotice` em setor inativo, propriedades (`<dl>`: status e selo de parada, setor só para o admin, destino, quem criou, origem com link para a passagem), itens com quantidade e unidade, "Mudar status" (só com `canMove`), linha do tempo e comentários; "Ver comentários anteriores" é sempre `<a href>` e some no teto de 500.
- **Usa:** `getRequestDetail`, `RequestStatusBadge`, `StaleBadge`, `RequestStatusActions`, `RequestTimeline`, `RequestComments`, `ReadOnlySectorNotice`.
- **Histórico:** {HOJE} — criado na Fase 4 (Tarefa 12).

### RequestSheet
- **Status:** ✅ pronto ({HOJE})
- **Local:** `src/components/solicitacoes/RequestSheet.tsx`
- **Propósito:** o Sheet do detalhe rápido (rota interceptada `@detalhe/(.)solicitacoes/[id]`).
- **Como funciona:** `"use client"`. `open` é constante: o slot só existe enquanto a URL é a do detalhe, e estado local não reabriria sob a Activity. Fechar (Escape, fundo ou o botão com texto "Fechar") chama `router.back()` uma vez só: a trava `closing` (um `ref` liberado no efeito de montagem) impede dois `back()` antes de a navegação terminar. Crie `test/openRequests.ts` (usado pelos testes dos quatro componentes):

```ts
import type {
  OpenRequestSummary,
  RequestAtDelivery,
} from "@/features/requests/types";

let counter = 0;

// Resumo de solicitação aberta para os testes de componente (seções da
// passagem e cartão do Início): id único, Solicitada, 1 dia, não parada.
export function openRequest(
  overrides: Partial<OpenRequestSummary> = {},
): OpenRequestSummary {
  counter += 1;
  return {
    id: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(counter).padStart(12, "0")}`,
    description: "Trocar redes do box 4",
    destinationName: "Doca 3",
    status: "requested",
    daysInStatus: 1,
    stale: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

export function requestAtDelivery(
  overrides: Partial<RequestAtDelivery> = {},
): RequestAtDelivery {
  const base = openRequest(overrides);
  return { ...base, statusNow: base.status, ...overrides };
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL } from "@/features/requests/status";
import { requestPreview } from "@/features/requests/text";
import type { OpenRequestSummary } from "@/features/requests/types";
import { requestHref } from "@/features/requests/urls";
import type { RequestStatus } from "@/lib/requestStatuses";

import { RequestStatusBadge } from "./RequestStatusBadge";
import { StaleBadge } from "./StaleBadge";

// Uma solicitação aberta nas seções da passagem e no cartão do Início. O link
// abre o detalhe rápido (Sheet interceptado, scroll={false}); `statusNow` só
// vem no resumo da entrega e diz onde a solicitação está hoje.
export function OpenRequestItem({
  request,
  statusNow,
}: {
  request: OpenRequestSummary;
  statusNow?: RequestStatus;
}) {
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-1 py-3">
      <Link
        href={requestHref(request.id)}
        scroll={false}
        className="inline-flex min-h-9 w-fit items-center font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline max-md:min-h-11"
      >
        {requestPreview(request.description)}
      </Link>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Para {request.destinationName}
      </p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <RequestStatusBadge status={request.status} />
        {request.stale && <StaleBadge days={request.daysInStatus} />}
        {statusNow !== undefined && statusNow !== request.status && (
          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Agora: {REQUEST_STATUS_LABEL[statusNow]}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { OpenRequestsNow } from "@/features/requests/types";

import { OpenRequestItem } from "./OpenRequestItem";

// Seção "Solicitações abertas" do formulário do rascunho: as abertas de agora
// (até 20, as mais antigas no status primeiro) e o atalho para criar uma nova
// ligada a esta passagem. Server-safe: `newRequest` é o botão de cliente.
export function OpenRequestsNowSection({
  data,
  allHref,
  newRequest,
}: {
  data: OpenRequestsNow;
  allHref: string;
  newRequest: ReactNode | null;
}) {
  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby="open-requests-now-heading"
      className="flex flex-col gap-3"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 id="open-requests-now-heading" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          Solicitações abertas
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Do setor, agora. As paradas há mais tempo aparecem primeiro.
        </p>
      </div>
      {data.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">Nenhuma solicitação aberta.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
          {data.rows.map((request) => (
            <OpenRequestItem key={request.id} request={request} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {data.total > data.rows.length && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          Mostrando {data.rows.length} de {data.total}.
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        {newRequest}
        <Link href={allHref} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost" })}>
          Ver todas as solicitações
        </Link>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

export function OpenRequestsAtDeliverySection({
  data,

}: {
  data: OpenRequestsAtDelivery;

}) {

      className="flex flex-col gap-3"

        >

        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {`Como estavam na entrega, em ${when}.`}
        </p>
      </div>
      {data.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
          Nenhuma solicitação aberta na entrega.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
          {data.rows.map((request) => (
            <OpenRequestItem
              key={request.id}
              request={request}
              statusNow={request.statusNow}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {data.total > data.rows.length && (

      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Link href={allHref} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost" })}>
          Ver todas as solicitações
        </Link>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";

  cookies: async () => ({
    get: (name: string) =>
      name === "closery_setor" && mocks.cookie.value !== undefined
        ? { name, value: mocks.cookie.value }
        : undefined,
  }),
}));
vi.mock("next/navigation", async () => ({
  ...(await vi.importActual<typeof import("next/navigation")>(
    "next/navigation",
  )),
  useRouter: () => ({ push: vi.fn() }),
}));
vi.mock("@/app/(app)/actions", () => ({ chooseSectorAction: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("@/app/(app)/passagens/actions", () => ({
  saveHandoverFieldAction: vi.fn(),
  deliverHandoverAction: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock("@/components/solicitacoes/NewRequestDialog", () => ({
  NewRequestDialog: (props: unknown) => {
    mocks.dialogProps.push(props);
    return <button type="button">Nova solicitação</button>;
  },
}));
vi.mock("@/db", async () => {
  const { createTestDb } = await import("../../../test/db");
  const { client, db } = await createTestDb();
  mocks.client = client;
  return { db };
});

const TODAY = "2026-11-20";

async function renderPage(search: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  render(
    <TooltipProvider>
      {await NewHandover({ searchParams: Promise.resolve(search) })}
    </TooltipProvider>,
  );
}

async function setup() {
  const uld = await insertSector(db, "ULD");
  const manha = await insertShift(db, {
    sectorId: uld.id,
    name: "Turno Manhã",
    startsAt: "06:00",
    endsAt: "14:00",
  });
  const fita = await insertItem(db, {
    sectorId: uld.id,
    name: "Fita adesiva",
    unit: "rolo",
    kind: "stock",
  });
  const rede = await insertItem(db, {
    sectorId: uld.id,
    name: "Rede de proteção",
    unit: "rolo",
    kind: "control",
  });
  const doca = await insertDestination(db, { name: "Doca 3" });
  const ana = await insertUser(db, {
    role: "operator",
    sectorId: uld.id,
    name: "Ana Teste",
  });
  return { uld, manha, fita, rede, doca, ana };
}

function asOperator(userId: string, sectorId: string) {
  mocks.requireUser.mockResolvedValue(
    authzOf({ role: "operator", userId, sectorId }),
  );
}

function lastDialogProps(): Record<string, unknown> {
  const props = mocks.dialogProps.at(-1);
  if (typeof props !== "object" || props === null) {
    throw new Error("o diálogo de nova solicitação não foi renderizado");
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(props));
}

describe("NewHandover: seção Solicitações abertas", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    if (mocks.client) await resetDb(mocks.client);
    mocks.requireUser.mockReset();
    mocks.cookie.value = undefined;
    mocks.dialogProps.length = 0;
    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["Date"] });
    vi.setSystemTime(spDate(TODAY, "10:00"));
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it("fica entre Estoque e Ocorrências do turno, com título, ajuda e atalhos", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    const heading = screen.getByRole("heading", {
      level: 2,
      name: "Solicitações abertas",
    });
    expect(
      screen.getByText(
        "Do setor, agora. As paradas há mais tempo aparecem primeiro.",
      ),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    const stock = screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Estoque" });
    const occurrences = screen.getByLabelText("Ocorrências do turno");
    expect(
      stock.compareDocumentPosition(heading) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING,
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(
      heading.compareDocumentPosition(occurrences) &
        Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING,
    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText("Nenhuma solicitação aberta.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Ver todas as solicitações" }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("href", "/solicitacoes");
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Nova solicitação" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("lista as abertas de agora, a mais antiga no status primeiro, e só as do setor", async () => {
    const { uld, ana, doca } = await setup();
    const carga = await insertSector(db, "Carga");
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      destinationId: doca.id,
      description: "Mais nova",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-19", "09:00"),
    });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      destinationOther: "Hangar 2",
      description: "Mais antiga",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-18", "09:00"),
      status: "in_transit",
      statusChangedAt: spDate("2026-11-18", "10:00"),
    });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      description: "Já entregue",
      status: "delivered",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-17", "09:00"),
      statusChangedAt: spDate("2026-11-17", "11:00"),
    });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      description: "Cancelada",
      status: "cancelled",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-17", "09:00"),
      statusChangedAt: spDate("2026-11-17", "11:00"),
    });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: carga.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      description: "De outro setor",
    });
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    const section = screen
      .getByRole("heading", { name: "Solicitações abertas" })
      .closest("section");
    if (!section) throw new Error("seção não encontrada");
    const items = within(section).getAllByRole("listitem");
    expect(items).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(items[0]).toHaveTextContent("Mais antiga");
    expect(items[0]).toHaveTextContent("Para Hangar 2");
    expect(items[0]).toHaveTextContent("Em separação / Trânsito");
    expect(items[1]).toHaveTextContent("Mais nova");
    expect(items[1]).toHaveTextContent("Para Doca 3");
    expect(screen.queryByText("Já entregue")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Cancelada")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("De outro setor")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("a parada de agora tem o selo com os dias (relógio de São Paulo)", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      description: "Esquecida",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-16", "09:00"),
    });
    await insertRequest(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      createdBy: ana.id,
      description: "Recente",
      createdAt: spDate("2026-11-19", "09:00"),
    });
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    expect(screen.getAllByText(/^Parada há /)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.getByText("Parada há 4 dias")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("com 21 abertas mostra 20 e 'Mostrando 20 de 21.'", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    for (let index = 0; index < 21; index += 1) {
      await insertRequest(db, {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        createdBy: ana.id,
        description: `Pedido ${index}`,
        createdAt: spDate("2026-11-19", "09:00"),
      });
    }
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    const section = screen
      .getByRole("heading", { name: "Solicitações abertas" })
      .closest("section");
    if (!section) throw new Error("seção não encontrada");
    expect(within(section).getAllByRole("listitem")).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(screen.getByText("Mostrando 20 de 21.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("'Nova solicitação' recebe o setor, as escolhas e a tripla da passagem como originRef", async () => {
    const { uld, manha, fita, doca, ana } = await setup();
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    expect(lastDialogProps()).toMatchObject({
      sectors: null,
      initialSectorId: uld.id,
      triggerVariant: "outline",
      originRef: {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        shiftId: manha.id,
        operationalDate: TODAY,
      },
      choices: {
        destinations: [{ id: doca.id, name: "Doca 3" }],
        bySector: {
          [uld.id]: {
            stockItems: [{ id: fita.id, name: "Fita adesiva", unit: "rolo" }],
            defaultDestinationId: doca.id,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  });

  it("o originRef acompanha o turno e o dia da URL", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    const tarde = await insertShift(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      name: "Turno Tarde",
      startsAt: "14:00",
      endsAt: "22:00",
    });
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage({ turno: tarde.id, data: "2026-11-19" });

    expect(lastDialogProps()).toMatchObject({
      originRef: {
        sectorId: uld.id,
        shiftId: tarde.id,
        operationalDate: "2026-11-19",
      },
    });
  });

  it("operador: 'Ver todas as solicitações' não leva ?setor=", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage({ setor: "qualquer" });

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Ver todas as solicitações" }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("href", "/solicitacoes");
  });

  it("admin: 'Ver todas as solicitações' leva ?setor= e o diálogo usa o setor escolhido", async () => {
    const { uld } = await setup();
    mocks.requireUser.mockResolvedValue(authzOf({ role: "admin" }));

    await renderPage({ setor: uld.id });

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Ver todas as solicitações" }),
    ).toHaveAttribute("href", `/solicitacoes?setor=${uld.id}`);
    expect(lastDialogProps()).toMatchObject({
      sectors: null,
      initialSectorId: uld.id,
    });
  });

  it("GET nunca escreve: a seção e o diálogo não criam passagem nem solicitação", async () => {
    const { uld, ana } = await setup();
    await insertRequest(db, { sectorId: uld.id, createdBy: ana.id });
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    const [handovers] = await db.select({ total: count() }).from(handover);
    const [requests] = await db.select({ total: count() }).from(request);
    expect(handovers?.total).toBe(0);
    expect(requests?.total).toBe(1);
  });

  it("setor sem itens de estoque: a seção aparece e as escolhas vêm sem itens", async () => {
    const uld = await insertSector(db, "ULD");
    await insertShift(db, { sectorId: uld.id, name: "Turno Manhã" });
    const ana = await insertUser(db, { role: "operator", sectorId: uld.id });
    asOperator(ana.id, uld.id);

    await renderPage();

    expect(
      screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Solicitações abertas" }),
    ).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(lastDialogProps()).toMatchObject({
      choices: {
        destinations: [],
        bySector: { [uld.id]: { stockItems: [], defaultDestinationId: null } },
      },
    });
  });

  it("setor inativo não mostra a seção nem monta o diálogo", async () => {
    const parado = await insertSector(db, "Parado", { active: false });
    const ana = await insertUser(db, { role: "operator", sectorId: parado.id });
    asOperator(ana.id, parado.id);

    await renderPage();

    expect(screen.getByText("Seu setor está inativo.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(
      screen.queryByRole("heading", { name: "Solicitações abertas" }),
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(mocks.dialogProps).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("passagem entregue redireciona e nunca mostra a seção do formulário", async () => {
    const { uld, manha, ana } = await setup();
    const bia = await insertUser(db, { role: "operator", sectorId: uld.id });
    await insertHandover(db, {
      sectorId: uld.id,
      shiftId: manha.id,
      operationalDate: TODAY,
      status: "delivered",
      deliveredBy: ana.id,
    });
    asOperator(bia.id, uld.id);

    await expect(
      NewHandover({ searchParams: Promise.resolve({}) }),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      digest: expect.stringContaining("NEXT_REDIRECT"),
    });
    expect(mocks.dialogProps).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

Componentes de domínio" e **acrescenta uma frase** ao fim das linhas `Como funciona`, `Usa` e `Histórico` de `Greeting`, `HomeHandovers`, `HandoverFields`, `HandoverForm`, `NewHandover` e `HandoverDetail`, sem depender do resto do texto (as Tarefas 3 e 10 a 12 também escrevem neste arquivo); se um bloco ou um trecho não existir, ele para sem gravar nada:

```js
import fs from "node:fs";

// A data do dia vem como argumento (regra do plano: `TZ=America/Sao_Paulo date +%F`).
const TODAY = process.argv[2];
if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(TODAY ?? "")) {
  throw new Error("passe a data do dia: node <script> $(TZ=America/Sao_Paulo date +%F)");
}

const file = ".context/ui-registry.md";
let text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");

// Acha o bloco "### Nome" (até o próximo "### " ou "## ").
function blockRange(name) {
  const begin = text.indexOf(`\n### ${name}\n`);
  if (begin === -1) throw new Error(`bloco não encontrado: ${name}`);
  const next = text.indexOf("\n### ", begin + 1);
  const nextSection = text.indexOf("\n## ", begin + 1);
  const ends = [next, nextSection].filter((index) => index !== -1);
  return [begin, ends.length > 0 ? Math.min(...ends) : text.length];
}

// Acrescenta uma frase ao fim de uma linha do bloco ("Como funciona", "Usa",
// "Histórico"), sem depender do resto do texto: outras tarefas também escrevem
// nestes blocos.
function appendToLine(name, label, sentence) {
  const [begin, end] = blockRange(name);
  const block = text.slice(begin, end);
  const at = block.indexOf(`- **${label}:**`);
  if (at === -1) throw new Error(`${name}: linha "${label}" não encontrada`);
  const lineEnd = block.indexOf("\n", at);
  const stop = lineEnd === -1 ? block.length : lineEnd;
  text = `${text.slice(0, begin)}${block.slice(0, stop)} ${sentence}${block.slice(stop)}${text.slice(end)}`;
}

function replaceInBlock(name, before, after) {
  const [begin, end] = blockRange(name);
  const block = text.slice(begin, end);
  if (!block.includes(before)) {
    throw new Error(`${name}: trecho não encontrado: ${before.slice(0, 50)}`);
  }
  text = `${text.slice(0, begin)}${block.replace(before, () => after)}${text.slice(end)}`;
}
